```javascript
import React from "react";
import { Box, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import { BarChart, Bar, Cell, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, LabelList, ResponsiveContainer } from "recharts";
import { COLORS } from "../../../../styles/theme";

const ColumnTooltip = ({ active, payload }) => {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null;
  const { name, value, fill } = payload[0].payload;
  return (
    <Box sx={{ bgcolor: COLORS.navyBlue, color: "#fff", px: 1.2, py: 0.8, borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: 12, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>

        <Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "2px", bgcolor: fill, flexShrink: 0 }} />
        <Box component="span">{name}: <b>{value}</b></Box>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

// ── Current-pipeline snapshot as independent columns — "Current" counts are
// candidates sitting in each stage right now, not a cumulative flow, so they
// aren't monotonically decreasing (e.g. "Onboarded" can be >= "Selected").
// A funnel's implied shrinkage would misrepresent that; plain columns show
// each stage's count on its own terms instead.
const CandidateStageColumnChart = ({ data = [], onSegmentClick, loading }) => {
  if (loading) {
    return <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 200, borderRadius: "10px", bgcolor: COLORS.bgPage }} />;
  }

  const hasData = data.some((d) => d.value > 0);
  if (!hasData) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 200, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 12, color: COLORS.textMuted }}>No pipeline data yet</Typography>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, height: "100%", overflow: "hidden", pb: 0.5 }}>

          <XAxis

          <YAxis
            allowDecimals={false}
            tick={{ fontSize: 10.5, fill: COLORS.textSecondary }}
            axisLine={false}
            tickLine={false}
            width={28}
          />
          <Tooltip content={<ColumnTooltip />} cursor={{ fill: `${COLORS.royalBlue}0A` }} />
          <Bar dataKey="value" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} maxBarSize={40} isAnimationActive animationDuration={700}>
            <LabelList dataKey="value" position="top" fill={COLORS.textPrimary} fontSize={11} fontWeight={600} />
            {data.map((entry) => (
              <Cell
                key={entry.key}
                fill={entry.fill}

                onClick={() => entry.value > 0 && onSegmentClick?.(entry.key)}
              />
            ))}
          </Bar>
```

```javascript
  return (

};

const DonutView = ({ data, total, large, isDesktop }) => (

          boxShadow: chartType === type ? "0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.12)" : "none",
        }}
      >
        {type}
      </Box>
    ))}
  </Box>
);

// ── Reusable donut — used for Candidate Experience & Offer Analysis. A view
// button opens the same chart, bigger, in a dialog with its own toggle. ─────
const DonutChart = ({ title, data = [], chartTypes = ["donut", "bar", "line"] }) => {
  const [chartType, setChartType] = useState("donut");
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDesktop = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.up("xl"));
  const tickFontSize = isDesktop ? 12 : 9.5;
  const total = data.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.value || 0), 0);
  const isEmpty = total === 0;

  const renderBody = (large) => {
    if (isEmpty) {
      return (
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
          <Typography sx={{ fontSize: large ? 16 : { xs: 11.5, xl: 13.5 }, color: COLORS.textMuted }}>No data yet</Typography>

      return <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}><CategoryBarTrend data={data} tickFontSize={large ? 15 : tickFontSize} large={large} isDesktop={isDesktop} /></Box>;
    }
    if (chartType === "line") {
      return <CategorySparkTrend data={data} total={total} large={large} isDesktop={isDesktop} />;
    }
    return <DonutView data={data} total={total} large={large} isDesktop={isDesktop} />;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Box sx={{
        bgcolor: "#fff", borderRadius: "12px", p: 1.5, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`,
        boxShadow: "0 2px 12px rgba(23,79,223,0.07)", height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",

      }}>

          <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: { xs: 12.5, xl: 16 }, color: COLORS.textPrimary }}>{title}</Typography>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 0.75 }}>
            <ToggleGroup chartType={chartType} onChange={setChartType} types={chartTypes} />
            <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setExpanded(true)} sx={{ width: 24, height: 24, color: COLORS.textMuted, "&:hover": { color: COLORS.royalBlue, bgcolor: "#EEF2FF" } }}>
              <OpenInFullOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13.5 }} />

        {renderBody(false)}

        controls={<ToggleGroup chartType={chartType} onChange={setChartType} large types={chartTypes} />}
      >
        {renderBody(true)}
      </ChartExpandDialog>
    </>
  );
```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Box, Typography } from "@mui/material";
import { Sparklines, SparklinesLine, SparklinesSpots } from "react-sparklines";
import { COLORS } from "../../../../styles/theme";

// react-sparklines v1 ships an `onMouseMove` propType but never wires it up —
// there's no built-in hover/tooltip support, so we lay our own even-width hit
// zones (one per data point) over the chart and position a small tooltip from
// the hovered index. Simpler and more reliable than reverse-engineering the
// library's internal point-spacing math.
const formatDateLabel = (label) => {
  if (typeof label === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(label)) {
    const [year, month] = label.split("-");
    return new Date(year, month - 1).toLocaleString("default", { month: "short", year: "numeric" });
  }
  return label ?? "";
};

const Sparkline = ({ values = [], labels = [], color = COLORS.royalBlue, uid, width = 96, height = 46 }) => {
  const [hoverIndex, setHoverIndex] = useState(null);

  if (!values.length) return <Box sx={{ width, height }} />;

  const hovered = hoverIndex != null ? { value: values[hoverIndex], label: formatDateLabel(labels[hoverIndex]) } : null;
  const hoverPct = hoverIndex != null ? ((hoverIndex + 0.5) / values.length) * 100 : 0;

  return (
    <Box sx={{ position: "relative", width, height }}>
      <Sparklines data={values} width={width} height={height} margin={4}>
        <SparklinesLine color={color} style={{ fill: color, fillOpacity: 0.18, strokeWidth: 2 }} />
        <SparklinesSpots size={2.5} style={{ fill: color }} spotColors={{ "-1": color }} />
      </Sparklines>

      {/* Invisible per-point hover zones */}
      <Box sx={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, display: "flex" }}>
        {values.map((_, i) => (
          <Box
            key={i}
            onMouseEnter={() => setHoverIndex(i)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setHoverIndex((prev) => (prev === i ? null : prev))}
            sx={{ flex: 1, height: "100%", cursor: "default" }}
          />
        ))}
      </Box>

      {hovered && (
        <Box
          sx={{
            // Anchored inside the sparkline's own box (not above it) since the
            // parent StatCard uses overflow:hidden for its accent-bar corner
            // radius — anything positioned outside these bounds gets clipped.
            position: "absolute",
            top: 1,
            left: `${hoverPct}%`,
            transform: hoverPct > 75 ? "translate(-90%, 0)" : hoverPct < 25 ? "translate(-10%, 0)" : "translate(-50%, 0)",
            bgcolor: COLORS.navyBlue,
            color: "#fff",
            px: 1,
            py: 0.5,
            borderRadius: "6px",
            fontSize: 10.5,
            whiteSpace: "nowrap",
            pointerEvents: "none",
            zIndex: 5,
            boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)",
          }}
        >
          {hovered.label && <Typography sx={{ fontSize: { xs: 9.5, xl: 11 }, opacity: 0.8, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>{hovered.label}</Typography>}
          <Typography sx={{ fontSize: { xs: 11.5, xl: 13 }, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>{hovered.value}</Typography>
        </Box>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Sparkline;

```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Box, Typography, IconButton, useTheme, useMediaQuery } from "@mui/material";
import OpenInFullOutlinedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/OpenInFullOutlined";
import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer } from "recharts";
import Sparkline from "./Sparkline";
import ChartExpandDialog from "./ChartExpandDialog";
import { COLORS } from "../../../../styles/theme";

// Some brand colors (e.g. COLORS.skyBlue) are already 8-digit #RRGGBBAA hex —
// naively appending another alpha suffix produces an invalid 10-digit hex
// that the browser silently drops, so strip any existing alpha first.
const withAlpha = (hex, alpha) => `${hex.length === 9 ? hex.slice(0, 7) : hex}${alpha}`;

const ChartTooltip = ({ active, payload, label }) => {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null;
  return (
    <Box sx={{ bgcolor: COLORS.navyBlue, color: "#fff", px: 1.4, py: 1, borderRadius: "8px", fontSize: { xs: 12, xl: 14 }, minWidth: 100 }}>
      <Box sx={{ fontWeight: 700, mb: 0.5 }}>{label}</Box>
      {payload.map((p) => (
        <Box key={p.dataKey} sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 0.8, mt: 0.3 }}>
          <Box sx={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", bgcolor: p.color, flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <Box component="span">{p.name}: <b>{p.value}</b></Box>
        </Box>
      ))}
    </Box>
  );
};

// ── "line" mode — one spark-chart row per series, instead of a full axis chart ──
const SparkRows = ({ data, series, xKey, large, isDesktop }) => {
  const labels = data.map((row) => row[xKey]);
  const sparkSize = large ? { width: 130, height: 46 } : { width: isDesktop ? 140 : 84, height: isDesktop ? 40 : 30 };
  return (
    <Box sx={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", justifyContent: "space-between", minHeight: 0, gap: large ? 1.5 : 0.5 }}>
      {series.map((s) => {
        const values = data.map((row) => row[s.key] || 0);
        return (
          <Box
            key={s.key}
            sx={{
              display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: large ? 2 : 1.5, minHeight: 0,
              px: large ? 2 : 1.5, py: large ? 1.25 : 1,
              borderRadius: large ? "10px" : "8px",
              border: `1px solid ${withAlpha(s.color, "33")}`,
            }}
          >
            <Typography noWrap sx={{ width: large ? 100 : { xs: 62, xl: 82 }, flexShrink: 0, fontSize: large ? 15 : { xs: 10.5, xl: 13.5 }, color: COLORS.textSecondary }}>{s.label}</Typography>
            <Typography sx={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "center", fontSize: large ? 22 : { xs: 13, xl: 16 }, fontWeight: 700, color: COLORS.textPrimary, lineHeight: 1.1 }}>
              {values.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0)}
            </Typography>
            <Box sx={{ width: sparkSize.width, height: sparkSize.height, flexShrink: 0, pl: large ? 1 : 0.75 }}>
              <Sparkline values={values} labels={labels} color={s.color} uid={s.key} width={sparkSize.width} height={sparkSize.height} />
            </Box>
          </Box>
        );
      })}
    </Box>
  );
};

const ToggleGroup = ({ chartType, onChange, large }) => (
  <Box sx={{ display: "flex", p: "2px", borderRadius: 1.5, bgcolor: "#F1F5F9" }}>
    {["line", "bar"].map((type) => (
      <Box
        key={type}
        onClick={() => onChange(type)}
        sx={{
          px: large ? 1.2 : 0.7, py: large ? 0.4 : 0.2, borderRadius: 1, cursor: "pointer",
          fontSize: large ? 14 : { xs: 9.5, xl: 11.5 }, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "capitalize",
          bgcolor: chartType === type ? "#fff" : "transparent",
          color: chartType === type ? COLORS.royalBlue : COLORS.textMuted,
          boxShadow: chartType === type ? "0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.12)" : "none",
        }}
      >
        {type}
      </Box>
    ))}
  </Box>
);

const BarView = ({ data, series, xKey, tickFontSize, legendFontSize }) => (
  <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
    <BarChart data={data} margin={{ top: 4, right: 4, bottom: 0, left: -24 }}>
      <CartesianGrid vertical={false} stroke={COLORS.border} />
      <XAxis dataKey={xKey} tick={{ fontSize: tickFontSize, fill: COLORS.textSecondary }} axisLine={{ stroke: COLORS.border }} tickLine={false} />
      <YAxis allowDecimals={false} tick={{ fontSize: tickFontSize, fill: COLORS.textSecondary }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} width={30} />
      <Tooltip content={<ChartTooltip />} cursor={{ fill: `${COLORS.royalBlue}0A` }} />
      <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: legendFontSize }} iconType="circle" iconSize={7} />
      {series.map((s) => (
        <Bar key={s.key} dataKey={s.key} name={s.label} fill={s.color} radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} maxBarSize={18} />
      ))}
    </BarChart>
  </ResponsiveContainer>
);

// ── Reusable multi-series chart used for Pipeline Trend — "line" is a spark-row
// list, "bar" is the full axis/legend chart. A view button opens the same chart,
// bigger, in a dialog with its own (shared-state) toggle. ────────────────────
const TrendLineChart = ({ title, data = [], series = [], xKey = "label" }) => {
  const [chartType, setChartType] = useState("line");
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const theme = useTheme();
  const isDesktop = useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.up("xl"));
  const tickFontSize = isDesktop ? 13 : 10.5;
  const legendFontSize = isDesktop ? 13 : 10.5;

  return (
    <>
      <Box sx={{
        bgcolor: "#fff", p: 1.5, borderRadius: "12px", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`,
        boxShadow: "0 2px 12px rgba(23,79,223,0.07)", height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 1, mb: 0.5 }}>
          <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: { xs: 12.5, xl: 16 }, color: COLORS.textPrimary }}>{title}</Typography>
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 0.75 }}>
            <ToggleGroup chartType={chartType} onChange={setChartType} />
            <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setExpanded(true)} sx={{ width: 24, height: 24, color: COLORS.textMuted, "&:hover": { color: COLORS.royalBlue, bgcolor: "#EEF2FF" } }}>
              <OpenInFullOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13.5 }} />
            </IconButton>
          </Box>
        </Box>
        {chartType === "line" ? (
          <SparkRows data={data} series={series} xKey={xKey} isDesktop={isDesktop} />
        ) : (
          <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
            <BarView data={data} series={series} xKey={xKey} tickFontSize={tickFontSize} legendFontSize={legendFontSize} />
          </Box>
        )}
      </Box>

      <ChartExpandDialog
        open={expanded}
        onClose={() => setExpanded(false)}
        title={title}
        controls={<ToggleGroup chartType={chartType} onChange={setChartType} large />}
      >
        {chartType === "line" ? (
          <SparkRows data={data} series={series} xKey={xKey} large />
        ) : (
          <BarView data={data} series={series} xKey={xKey} tickFontSize={14} legendFontSize={14} />
        )}
      </ChartExpandDialog>
    </>
  );
};

export default TrendLineChart;
```

```javascript
/* =========================================
   FORM CONFIG

   `name` matches the API payload keys, so the
   values can be sent as they are (after trim).
   Set `required: true/false` to change what

========================================= */

const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

const isValidPhone = (value) => {
  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "");

  return (
    /^\+?[\d\s\-()]+$/.test(value) &&
    digits.length >= 7 &&
    digits.length <= 15
  );
};

const FIELDS = [
  {
    name: "name",
    label: "Full name",
    placeholder: "Full name",
    required: true,
    requiredMessage: "Enter the customer's name",
  },
  {
    name: "email",
    label: "Email",
    placeholder: "name@company.com",
    type: "email",
    required: true,
    requiredMessage: "Enter an email address",
    check: (value) =>
      EMAIL_PATTERN.test(value)
        ? ""
        : "Enter a valid email address",
  },
  {
    name: "phone_number",
    label: "Phone",
    placeholder: "+91 98765 43210",
    type: "tel",
    required: true,
    requiredMessage: "Enter a phone number",
    check: (value) =>
      isValidPhone(value)
        ? ""
        : "Enter a valid phone number (7–15 digits)",
  },
  {
    name: "company_name",
    label: "Company",
    placeholder: "Company name",
    required: true,
    requiredMessage: "Enter the company name",
  },
  {
    name: "message",
    label: "Message",
    placeholder: "Context for the team, e.g. how the customer reached out",
    multiline: true,
    required: false,
  },
];

const INITIAL_VALUES = Object.fromEntries(
  FIELDS.map(({ name }) => [name, ""])
);

/* =========================================
   HELPERS
========================================= */

const validate = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  FIELDS.forEach(
    ({ name, required, requiredMessage, check }) => {
      const value = values[name].trim();

      if (!value) {
        if (required) {
          errors[name] = requiredMessage;
        }
        return;
      }

      const message = check?.(value);

      if (message) {
        errors[name] = message;
      }
    }
  );

  return errors;
};

const toPayload = (values) =>
  Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(values).map(([key, value]) => [
      key,
      value.trim(),
    ])
  );

/*
 * RTK Query's unwrap() rejects with
 * { status, data } – read the API message
 * first, then fall back to a generic one.
 */

const getErrorMessage = (error) => {
  const data = error?.data;

  if (typeof data?.message === "string" && data.message) {
    return data.message;
  }

  if (typeof data?.detail === "string" && data.detail) {
    return data.detail;
  }

  if (typeof data?.detail?.[0]?.msg === "string") {
    return data.detail[0].msg;
  }

  if (error?.status === "FETCH_ERROR") {
    return "Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.";
  }

  return "Couldn't add the request. Check the details and try again.";
};

const RequestForm = ({
  isSubmitting,
  onSubmit,
  onCancel,
}) => {
  const [values, setValues] = useState(INITIAL_VALUES);
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState("");

  const errors = validate(values);

  const handleChange = (event) => {
    const { name, value } = event.target;

    setValues((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [name]: value,
    }));

    setServerError("");
  };

  const handleBlur = (event) => {
    const { name } = event.target;

    setTouched((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [name]: true,
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    /* Reveal every error on the first submit attempt */
    setTouched(
      Object.fromEntries(
        FIELDS.map(({ name }) => [name, true])
      )
    );

    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await onSubmit(toPayload(values));
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(getErrorMessage(error));
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box
      component="form"
      noValidate
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      sx={{
        display: "flex",
        flexDirection: "column",
        flex: "1 1 auto",
        minHeight: 0,
        ...formFontSx,
      }}
    >
      {/* Header */}

      <Box
        sx={{
          px: 3,
          pt: 2.5,
          pb: 2,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${TOKENS.border}`,
        }}
      >
        <Typography
          id="add-demo-request-title"
          sx={{
            fontSize: 17,
            fontWeight: 700,
            lineHeight: 1.3,
            color: TOKENS.textPrimary,
          }}
        >
          Add request manually
        </Typography>

        <Typography
          sx={{
            mt: 0.5,
            fontSize: 12.5,
            color: TOKENS.textSecondary,
          }}
        >
          Create a request on behalf of a customer. It is
          added to the list with the status New.
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      {/* Fields */}

      <DialogContent sx={{ px: 3, py: 2.5 }}>
        {serverError && (
          <Alert
            severity="error"
            sx={{ mb: 2, fontSize: 12.5, borderRadius: "8px" }}
          >
            {serverError}
          </Alert>
        )}

        <Box
          sx={{
            display: "grid",
            gridTemplateColumns: {
              xs: "1fr",
              sm: "1fr 1fr",
            },
            gap: 2,
          }}
        >
          {FIELDS.map((field, index) => {
            const inputId = `add-demo-request-${field.name}`;
            const error =
              touched[field.name] && errors[field.name];

            return (
              <Box
                key={field.name}
                sx={{
                  gridColumn: field.multiline
                    ? "1 / -1"
                    : "auto",
                }}
              >
                <Typography
                  component="label"
                  htmlFor={inputId}
                  sx={labelSx}
                >
                  {field.label}

                  {field.required && (
                    <Box
                      component="span"
                      sx={{ ml: 0.4, color: "error.main" }}
                    >
                      *
                    </Box>
                  )}
                </Typography>

                <TextField
                  id={inputId}
                  name={field.name}
                  type={field.type}
                  value={values[field.name]}
                  placeholder={field.placeholder}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  onBlur={handleBlur}
                  error={Boolean(error)}
                  helperText={error}
                  required={field.required}
                  multiline={field.multiline}
                  minRows={field.multiline ? 3 : undefined}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  autoFocus={index === 0}
                  /* This is somebody else's data, so don't
                     let the browser autofill the admin's own */
                  autoComplete="off"
                  size="small"
                  fullWidth
                  sx={inputSx}
                />
              </Box>
            );
          })}
        </Box>
      </DialogContent>

      {/* Actions */}

      <DialogActions
        sx={{
          px: 3,
          py: 2,
          borderTop: `1px solid ${TOKENS.border}`,
        }}
      >
        <Button
          variant="outlined"
          onClick={onCancel}
          disabled={isSubmitting}
          sx={secondaryButtonSx}
        >
          Cancel
        </Button>

        <Button
          type="submit"
          variant="contained"
          disabled={isSubmitting}
          startIcon={
            isSubmitting ? (
              <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />
            ) : null
          }
          sx={primaryButtonSx}
        >
          {isSubmitting ? "Adding..." : "Add request"}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Box>
  );
};

/* =========================================
   TRIGGER BUTTON + DIALOG + TOAST

   POST /acc/demo-requests/create-on-behalf
========================================= */

const AddDemoRequest = () => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const [toastOpen, setToastOpen] = useState(false);

  const [createDemoRequest, { isLoading }] =
    useCreateDemoRequestOnBehalfMutation();

  const handleClose = () => {
    /* Don't dismiss while the request is in flight */
    if (!isLoading) {
      setOpen(false);
    }
  };

  /*
   * Throws on failure (unwrap) so the form can show
   * the API error and keep what the user typed.
   *
   * The demo requests list refreshes through the
   * tag invalidated by the mutation.
   */

  const handleCreate = async (payload) => {
    await createDemoRequest(payload).unwrap();

    setOpen(false);
    setToastOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        variant="contained"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        sx={primaryButtonSx}
      >
        Add request manually
      </Button>

      <Dialog
        open={open}
        onClose={handleClose}
        fullWidth
        maxWidth="sm"
        aria-labelledby="add-demo-request-title"
        sx={{
          "& .MuiDialog-paper": { borderRadius: "12px" },
        }}
      >
        <RequestForm
          isSubmitting={isLoading}
          onSubmit={handleCreate}
          onCancel={handleClose}
        />
      </Dialog>

      <Snackbar
        open={toastOpen}
        autoHideDuration={4000}
        onClose={(_, reason) => {
          if (reason !== "clickaway") {
            setToastOpen(false);
          }
        }}
        anchorOrigin={{
          vertical: "top",
          horizontal: "right",
        }}
      >
        <Alert
          severity="success"
          variant="filled"
          onClose={() => setToastOpen(false)}
          sx={{
            fontSize: 13,
            fontFamily: TOKENS.fontFamily,
          }}
        >
          Request added
        </Alert>
      </Snackbar>
    </>
  );
};

export default AddDemoRequest;
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";

);

const getErrorMessage = (error, fallback) =>
  typeof error?.data?.message === "string"
    ? error.data.message
    : typeof error?.data?.detail === "string"
      ? error.data.detail
      : typeof error?.message === "string"
        ? error.message
        : fallback;
/* =========================================

const DemoRequestDetails = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { demoRequestId } = useParams();

  const [inviteMenuAnchor, setInviteMenuAnchor] = useState(null);
  const [inviteSent, setInviteSent] = useState(false);
  const [latestInviteResponse, setLatestInviteResponse] = useState(null);
  const [isSendingInvite, setIsSendingInvite] = useState(false);
  const [amProvisionedOpen, setAmProvisionedOpen] = useState(false);
  const [requestOverride, setRequestOverride] = useState(null);
  const [amProvisionedForm, setAmProvisionedForm] = useState({
    organisation_name: "",
    email: "",
    first_name: "",
    last_name: "",
    phone_number: "",
    time_zone: "Asia/Kolkata",
    country: "",
    industry: "",
    website_url: "",
  });

  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch, isFetching } =
    useGetDemoRequestsQuery({});

  const {
    data: statusData,
    isLoading: isStatusLoading,
    isError: isStatusError,
  } = useGetDemoRequestStatusesQuery();

  const {
    data: onboardingData,
    isLoading: isOnboardingLoading,
    isError: isOnboardingError,
    refetch: refetchOnboarding,
  } = useGetDemoRequestOnboardingStatusQuery(demoRequestId, {
    skip: !demoRequestId,
  });

  const {

    isLoading: isUsersLoading,
    isError: isUsersError,
  } = useGetAllInternalUsersQuery();

  const [updateDemoRequestStatus, { isLoading: isUpdatingStatus }] =
    useUpdateDemoRequestStatusMutation();

  const [assignDemoRequest, { isLoading: isAssigning }] =
    useAssignDemoRequestMutation();

  const [resendDemoRequestInvite, { isLoading: isResendingInvite }] =
    useResendDemoRequestInviteMutation();

  const [sendProvisionCredentials, { isLoading: isSendingProvisionCredentials }] =
    useSendProvisionCredentialsMutation();
  const [pendingCredentialsOnboardingId, setPendingCredentialsOnboardingId] = useState(null);

  const companies = data?.data ?? [];
  const statuses = statusData?.data ?? [];
  const users = usersData?.data ?? [];
  const onboarding = onboardingData?.data ?? null;
  const onboardingInfo = onboarding?.onboarding ?? null;
  const onboardingTracking = onboarding?.tracking ?? null;

  const requests = companies.flatMap((company) =>
    (company.requests || []).map((item) => ({
      ...item,
      company_name: company.company_name,
    }))
  );

  const requestFromApi = requests.find(
    (item) => String(item.demo_request_id) === String(demoRequestId)
  );
  const request = requestOverride || requestFromApi;

  useEffect(() => {
    const hasExistingInvite = Boolean(
      onboardingInfo?.invite_token_sent ||

        onboardingTracking?.is_invitation_sent ||
        onboardingTracking?.is_registration_completed ||
        onboardingTracking?.is_onboarding_completed
    );

    if (hasExistingInvite) setInviteSent(true);
  }, [onboardingInfo, onboardingTracking]);

  const handleStatusChange = async (newStatus) => {

    try {

      const assignment = response?.data ?? response;
      setRequestOverride({
```

```javascript
import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  CircularProgress,
  Alert,
  Select,
  MenuItem,
  Paper,
  TextField,
  InputAdornment,
} from "@mui/material";

import SearchIcon from "@mui/icons-material/Search";



import {
  useGetDemoRequestsQuery,
  useGetDemoRequestStatusesQuery,
  useGetAllInternalUsersQuery,
} from "../../redux/services/demo/demo";

import {
  TOKENS,
  StatusPill,
  formatDate,
  DEMO_REQUESTS_PATH,
} from "./demoRequestUi";
import ReusableMRT from "../../components/table";
import AddDemoRequest from "./AddDemoRequest";

/* =========================================
   SHARED STYLES
========================================= */

const filterSelectSx = {
  minWidth: 150,
  height: 34,
  fontSize: 12.5,
  color: TOKENS.textPrimary,
  borderRadius: "8px",
  backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
  "& .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline": {
    borderColor: TOKENS.border,
  },
};

/* Column header look (grey bar like the design) */
const headCellProps = {
  sx: {
    backgroundColor: `${TOKENS.headerBg} !important`,
    color: TOKENS.textSecondary,
    fontSize: 12.5,
    fontWeight: 500,
    fontFamily: TOKENS.fontFamily,
  },
};

const DemoRequests = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  /* =========================================
     FILTER / SEARCH
  ========================================= */

  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  /* =========================================
     API
  ========================================= */

  const { data, isLoading, isError } =
    useGetDemoRequestsQuery(
      status ? { status } : {},
      {
        pollingInterval: 30_000,
        refetchOnFocus: true,
        refetchOnReconnect: true,
      }
    );

  const {
    data: statusData,
    isLoading: isStatusLoading,
    isError: isStatusError,
  } = useGetDemoRequestStatusesQuery();

  const { data: usersData } =
    useGetAllInternalUsersQuery();

  /* =========================================
     DATA
  ========================================= */

  const companies = data?.data ?? [];
  const statuses = statusData?.data ?? [];
  const users = usersData?.data ?? [];

  /*
   * Convert grouped company response
   * into flat request list.
   */

  const requests = companies.flatMap((company) =>
    (company.requests || []).map((request) => ({
      ...request,
      company_name: company.company_name,
    }))
  );

  /* =========================================
     SEARCH
  ========================================= */

  const filteredRequests = requests.filter(
    (request) => {
      const searchValue = search
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();

      if (!searchValue) {
        return true;
      }

      return (
        request.name
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .includes(searchValue) ||
        request.email
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .includes(searchValue) ||
        request.phone_number
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .includes(searchValue) ||
        request.company_name
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .includes(searchValue)
      );
    }
  );

  /* =========================================
     COLUMNS  (must stay above early returns)
  ========================================= */

  const columnData = useMemo(() => {
    const getStatusLabel = (value) =>
      statuses.find((item) => item.value === value)
        ?.label ||
      value ||
      "-";

    const getUserName = (userId) =>
      users.find((item) => item.id === userId)
        ?.full_name || "";

    return [
      {
        accessorKey: "name",
        header: "Name",
        muiTableHeadCellProps: headCellProps,
        cellSx: {
          color: TOKENS.textPrimary,
          fontWeight: 500,
        },
        Cell: ({ row }) => row.original.name || "-",
      },
      {
        accessorKey: "company_name",
        header: "Company",
        muiTableHeadCellProps: headCellProps,
        Cell: ({ row }) =>
          row.original.company_name || "-",
      },
      {
        accessorKey: "email",
        header: "Email",
        muiTableHeadCellProps: headCellProps,
        Cell: ({ row }) => row.original.email || "-",
      },
      {
        accessorKey: "phone_number",
        header: "Phone",
        muiTableHeadCellProps: headCellProps,
        Cell: ({ row }) =>
          row.original.phone_number || "-",
      },
      {
        id: "status",
        header: "Status",
        accessorFn: (row) => getStatusLabel(row.status),
        muiTableHeadCellProps: headCellProps,
        Cell: ({ row }) => (
          <StatusPill
            value={row.original.status}
            label={getStatusLabel(row.original.status)}
          />
        ),
      },
      {
        id: "assigned_to",
        header: "Assigned To",
        accessorFn: (row) =>
          getUserName(row.assigned_to) || "Unassigned",
        muiTableHeadCellProps: headCellProps,
        Cell: ({ row }) => {
          const name = getUserName(
            row.original.assigned_to
          );

          return (
            <Box
              component="span"
              sx={{
                color: name
                  ? TOKENS.textSecondary
                  : TOKENS.textMuted,
              }}
            >
              {name || "Unassigned"}
            </Box>
          );
        },
      },
      {
        accessorKey: "created_at",
        header: "Created",
        muiTableHeadCellProps: headCellProps,
        Cell: ({ row }) =>
          formatDate(row.original.created_at),
      },
    ];
  }, [statuses, users]);

  /* =========================================
     LOADING / ERROR
  ========================================= */

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <Box
        display="flex"
        justifyContent="center"
        py={8}
      >
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <Alert severity="error">
        Failed to load demo requests.
      </Alert>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        p: 1,
        width: "100%",
        minHeight: "100%",
        backgroundColor: TOKENS.pageBg,
        fontFamily: TOKENS.fontFamily,
      }}
    >
      {/* =====================================
          PAGE HEADER
      ===================================== */}

      <Box sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
        <Typography
          sx={{
            fontSize: 24,
            fontWeight: 700,
            color: TOKENS.textPrimary,
            lineHeight: 1.2,
          }}
        >
          Demo Requests
        </Typography>

        <Typography
          sx={{
            fontSize: 13,
            color: TOKENS.textSecondary,
            mt: 0.5,
          }}
        >
          Track incoming demo requests, assign owners
          and send customer invitations.
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      {/* =====================================
          CARD
      ===================================== */}

      <Paper
        elevation={0}
        sx={{
          border: `1px solid ${TOKENS.border}`,
          borderRadius: "12px",
          backgroundColor: TOKENS.cardBg,
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        {/* Toolbar */}

        <Box
          sx={{
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            gap: 2,
            p: 2,
          }}
        >
          <TextField
            size="small"
            placeholder="Search"
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setSearch(event.target.value)
            }
            sx={{
              width: 260,
              "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {
                height: 34,
                borderRadius: "8px",
                fontSize: 12.5,
                backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
                "& fieldset": {
                  borderColor: TOKENS.border,
                },
              },
            }}
            InputProps={{
              startAdornment: (
                <InputAdornment position="start">
                  <SearchIcon
                    sx={{
                      fontSize: 17,
                      color: TOKENS.textMuted,
                    }}
                  />
                </InputAdornment>
              ),
            }}
          />

          <Box
            sx={{
              display: "flex",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 1.5,
            }}
          >
            <Select
              size="small"
              value={status}
              displayEmpty
              onChange={(event) =>
                setStatus(event.target.value)
              }
              disabled={
                isStatusLoading || isStatusError
              }
              sx={filterSelectSx}
            >
              <MenuItem value="">
                Filter by status
              </MenuItem>

              {statuses.map((item) => (
                <MenuItem
                  key={item.value}
                  value={item.value}
                  sx={{ fontSize: 13 }}
                >
                  {item.label}
                </MenuItem>
              ))}
            </Select>

            {/* POST /acc/demo-requests/create-on-behalf */}
            <AddDemoRequest />
          </Box>
        </Box>

        {/* Reusable table */}

        <ReusableMRT
          data={filteredRequests}
          columnData={columnData}
          height="calc(100vh - 215px)"
          enableRowActions={false}
          enableRowSelection={false}
          enableRowClickModal={false}
          enableGlobalFilter={false}
          onRowClick={(request) =>
            navigate(
              `${DEMO_REQUESTS_PATH}/${request.demo_request_id}`
            )
          }
        />
      </Paper>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default DemoRequests;
```

```javascript
import React from "react";
import { Box } from "@mui/material";

/* =========================================
   ROUTES
========================================= */

export const DEMO_REQUESTS_PATH = "/account-manager/requests/demo";
export const TOKENS = {
  pageBg: "#FAFAFA",
  cardBg: "#FFFFFF",
  border: "#E8E8EC",
  headerBg: "#F3F3F4",
  textPrimary: "#1F2937",
  textSecondary: "#6B7280",
  textMuted: "#9CA3AF",
  accent: "#FF9F43",
  accentHover: "#F28C28",
  fontFamily:
    '"Plus Jakarta Sans", "Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif',
};

/* =========================================
   STATUS COLORS
   Keys = status "value" returned by API
========================================= */

const STATUS_STYLES = {
  new: { bg: "#FF9F43", color: "#FFFFFF" },
  contacted: { bg: "#2FB67C", color: "#FFFFFF" },
  meeting_scheduled: { bg: "#7C5CFC", color: "#FFFFFF" },
  onboarding: { bg: "#0B3FD9", color: "#FFFFFF" },
  mailed: { bg: "#0B3FD9", color: "#FFFFFF" },
  converted: { bg: "#16A34A", color: "#FFFFFF" },
  lost: { bg: "#EF4444", color: "#FFFFFF" },
};

const FALLBACK_STATUS = { bg: "#6B7280", color: "#FFFFFF" };

/* =========================================
   STATUS PILL
========================================= */

export const StatusPill = ({ value, label }) => {
  const style = STATUS_STYLES[value] || FALLBACK_STATUS;

  return (
    <Box
      component="span"
      sx={{
        display: "inline-flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: 0.6,
        height: 20,
        px: 1,
        borderRadius: "5px",
        fontSize: 10.5,
        fontWeight: 500,
        lineHeight: 1,
        whiteSpace: "nowrap",
        backgroundColor: style.bg,
        color: style.color,
      }}
    >
      <Box
        component="span"
        sx={{
          width: 4,
          height: 4,
          borderRadius: "50%",
          backgroundColor: "currentColor",
        }}
      />
      {label || value || "-"}
    </Box>
  );
};

/* =========================================
   DATE FORMAT  ->  29 Sep 2026
========================================= */

export const formatDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "-";

  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "-";

  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
};
```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Typography, TextField, Button, Box } from "@mui/material";
import { useForgotPasswordMutation } from "../../redux/services/auth/auth";
import { toast } from "react-toastify";
import { AC_ACCESS_TOKEN, ACCESS_TOKEN, setItem } from "../../utils/constants";

const EmailStep = ({ onNext }) => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");

  const [forgotPassword, { isLoading }] =
    useForgotPasswordMutation();

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!email.trim()) {
      toast.error("Email is required");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await forgotPassword({ email }).unwrap();
      toast.success("OTP sent to email ✅");
      console.log("Forgot Password Response:", res.data);
      if(res?.success){
        setItem(AC_ACCESS_TOKEN, res.data.temp_access_token);
        onNext(email);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || "Failed to send OTP");
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        minHeight: "100vh",
        display: "flex",
        justifyContent: "center",
        alignItems: "center",
        backgroundColor: "#f3f4f6",
      }}
    >
      {/* CARD */}
      <Box
        sx={{
          width: 360,
          p: 4,
          borderRadius: "20px",
          backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
          boxShadow: "0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          gap: 2, // ✅ proper spacing instead of spacing prop
        }}
      >
        {/* TITLE */}
        <Typography
          fontSize={22}
          fontWeight={600}
          textAlign="center"
        >
          Forgot Password
        </Typography>

        {/* EMAIL */}
        <TextField
          fullWidth
          placeholder="Enter your email"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          sx={{
            "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {
              borderRadius: "10px",
              backgroundColor: "#FAFAFA",
              height: "48px",
            },
          }}
        />

        {/* BUTTON */}
        <Button
          fullWidth
          onClick={handleSend}
          disabled={isLoading}
          sx={{
            height: "48px",
            backgroundColor: "#FE9F43",
            borderRadius: "10px",
            color: "#fff",
            textTransform: "none",
          }}
        >
          {isLoading ? "Sending..." : "Send OTP"}
        </Button>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default EmailStep;
```

## File: pages/ForgotPassword/OtpStep.jsx

```javascript
import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Typography, Box, Button, TextField } from "@mui/material";
import {
  useForgotVerifyOTPMutation,
  useForgotPasswordMutation,
  useForgotResendOTPMutation,
} from "../../redux/services/auth/auth";
import { toast } from "react-toastify";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

const OtpStep = ({ onNext, email }) => {
  const inputs = useRef([]);
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState(Array(6).fill(""));
  const [timer, setTimer] = useState(30);
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");

  const [verifyOTP, { isLoading: verifying }] = useForgotVerifyOTPMutation();

  const [forgotPassword] = useForgotPasswordMutation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [resendOtp, { isLoading: resending }] = useForgotResendOTPMutation();

  // ⏱ Timer
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setTimer((prev) => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : 0));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // 🔢 OTP input
  const handleChange = (value, index) => {
    if (!/^[0-9]?$/.test(value)) return;

    const newOtp = [...otp];
    newOtp[index] = value;
    setOtp(newOtp);

    if (value && index < 5) {
      inputs.current[index + 1].focus();
    }
  };

  // ✅ VERIFY + RESET PASSWORD
  const handleVerify = async () => {
    const finalOtp = otp.join("");

    if (finalOtp.length !== 6) {
      toast.error("Enter valid OTP");
      return;
    }

    if (!password || password !== confirmPassword) {
      toast.error("Passwords do not match");
      return;
    }

    try {
      await verifyOTP({
        otp: finalOtp,
        password,
        confirmPassword,
      }).unwrap();

      toast.success("Password reset successful ✅");
      navigate("/login");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || "Verification failed");
    }
  };

  // 🔁 RESEND OTP
  const handleResend = async () => {
    try {
      await resendOtp({ email }).unwrap();
      toast.success("OTP resent successfully");
      setTimer(30);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || "Failed to resend OTP");
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        minHeight: "100vh",
        display: "flex",
        justifyContent: "center",
        alignItems: "center",
        backgroundColor: "#f3f4f6",
      }}
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          width: 360,
          p: 4,
          borderRadius: "20px",
          backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
          boxShadow: "0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",
        }}
      >
        <Typography fontSize={22} fontWeight={600} textAlign="center" mb={3}>
          Verify OTP
        </Typography>

        {/* OTP */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            mb: 3,
          }}
        >
          {otp.map((digit, index) => (
            <input
              key={index}
              ref={(el) => (inputs.current[index] = el)}
              value={digit}
              onChange={(e) => handleChange(e.target.value, index)}
              style={{
                width: 45,
                height: 45,
                textAlign: "center",
                fontSize: 18,
                borderRadius: 8,
                border: "1px solid #ccc",
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </Box>

        {/* PASSWORD */}
        <TextField
          fullWidth
          type="password"
          placeholder="New Password"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          sx={{ mb: 2 }}
        />

        <TextField
          fullWidth
          type="password"
          placeholder="Confirm Password"
          value={confirmPassword}
          onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
          sx={{ mb: 3 }}
        />

        {/* BUTTON */}
        <Button
          fullWidth
          onClick={handleVerify}
          disabled={verifying}
          sx={{
            height: "48px",
            backgroundColor: "#FE9F43",
            borderRadius: "10px",
            color: "#fff",
            mb: 2,
          }}
        >
          {verifying ? "Processing..." : "Verify & Reset"}
        </Button>

        {/* RESEND */}
        <Typography textAlign="center">
          {timer > 0 ? (
            `Resend in ${timer}s`
          ) : (
            <span
              style={{
                color: resending ? "#ccc" : "#FE9F43",
                cursor: resending ? "not-allowed" : "pointer",
              }}
              onClick={!resending ? handleResend : undefined}
            >
              {resending ? "Sending..." : "Resend OTP"}
            </span>
          )}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default OtpStep;

```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Stack,
  Typography,
  TextField,
  Button,
  Box,
} from "@mui/material";
import { resetPassword } from "./forgotApi";

const checkStrength = (password) => {
  let score = 0;

  if (password.length >= 6) score++;
  if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) score++;
  if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) score++;
  if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) score++;

  if (score <= 1) return { label: "Weak", color: "#E53935", width: "33%" };
  if (score === 2 || score === 3)
    return { label: "Medium", color: "#FBC02D", width: "66%" };
  return { label: "Strong", color: "#43A047", width: "100%" };
};

const AmResetPassword = ({ onNext }) => {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  const strength = checkStrength(password);

  const handleReset = async () => {
    await resetPassword(password);
    onNext();
  };

  return (
    <Stack spacing={3}>
      <Typography fontSize={22} fontWeight={600} textAlign="center">
        Reset Password
      </Typography>

      <TextField
        fullWidth
        type="password"
        placeholder="New Password"
        value={password}
        onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
        sx={{
          "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {
            borderRadius: "10px",
            backgroundColor: "#FAFAFA",
            height: "48px",
          },
        }}
      />

      {/* Strength Bar */}
      {password && (
        <Box>
          <Box
            sx={{
              height: 8,
              width: "100%",
              backgroundColor: "#E0E0E0",
              borderRadius: 5,
              overflow: "hidden",
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                height: "100%",
                width: strength.width,
                backgroundColor: strength.color,
                transition: "0.3s ease",
              }}
            />
          </Box>

          <Typography
            sx={{
              fontSize: 13,
              mt: 1,
              color: strength.color,
              fontWeight: 500,
            }}
          >
            {strength.label} Password
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      )}

      <Button
        fullWidth
        onClick={handleReset}
        sx={{
          height: "48px",
          backgroundColor: "#FE9F43",
          borderRadius: "10px",
          color: "#fff",
          "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#E68E36" },
        }}
      >
        Update Password
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  );
};

export default AmResetPassword;
```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import EmailStep from "./EmailStep";
import OtpStep from "./OtpStep";
import ResetStep from "./ResetStep";
import SuccessStep from "./SuccessStep";
import { Box } from "@mui/material";

const AmForgotPassword = () => {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(""); // ✅ store email

  return (
    <Box>
      {step === 1 && (
        <EmailStep
          onNext={(emailValue) => {
            setEmail(emailValue);  // ✅ save email
            setStep(2);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {step === 2 && (
        <OtpStep
          email={email}           // ✅ pass email
          onNext={() => setStep(3)}
        />
      )}

      {step === 3 && <ResetStep onNext={() => setStep(4)} />}
      {step === 4 && <SuccessStep />}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default AmForgotPassword;
```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  TextField,
  Button,
  Typography,
  InputAdornment,
  IconButton,
  Box,
  Stack,
} from "@mui/material";
import { Visibility, VisibilityOff } from "@mui/icons-material";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useLoginMutation } from "../../redux/services/auth/auth";
import { toast } from "react-toastify";
import { AC_ACCESS_TOKEN, AC_REFRESH_TOKEN, setItem } from "../../utils/constants";

const AmLogin = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [login, { isLoading }] = useLoginMutation();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  // ✅ error states
  const [emailError, setEmailError] = useState("");
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState("");

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    // 🔥 Reset errors
    setEmailError("");
    setPasswordError("");

    // ✅ VALIDATION
    let isValid = true;

    if (!email.trim()) {
      setEmailError("Email is required");
      isValid = false;
    }

    if (!password.trim()) {
      setPasswordError("Password is required");
      isValid = false;
    } else if (password.length < 6) {
      setPasswordError("Password must be at least 6 characters");
      isValid = false;
    }

    if (!isValid) return;

    try {
      const res = await login({ email, password }).unwrap();
      console.log("Login response:", res);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success(res?.message || "Login successful ✅");
        setItem(AC_ACCESS_TOKEN,res?.data?.access_token);
        setItem(AC_REFRESH_TOKEN,res?.data?.refresh_token);
        setItem("am_user", JSON.stringify(res?.data?.user));
        navigate("/account-manager/dashboard");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const message =
        err?.data?.message || err?.data?.detail || "Invalid email or password";

      // 🔥 show API error under password
      setPasswordError(message);

      toast.error(message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        minHeight: "100vh",
        width: "100%",
        display: "flex",
        justifyContent: "center",
        alignItems: "center",
        backgroundColor: "#f3f4f6",
      }}
    >
      <Box
        component="form"
        onSubmit={handleLogin}
        sx={{
          p: 4,
          borderRadius: "24px",
          backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
          boxShadow: "0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",
          mt: -8,
          width: { xs: "90%", sm: "400px" },
        }}
      >
        <Stack spacing={3}>
          {/* Title */}
          <Box textAlign="center">
            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 600 }}>
              Sign In
            </Typography>
            {/* <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 500, mt: 1 }}>
              Your All-in-One Client Hiring Command Center
            </Typography> */}
          </Box>

          {/* Email */}
          <TextField
            fullWidth
            label="Email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            error={!!emailError} // 🔥
            helperText={emailError} // 🔥
            sx={{
              "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {
                borderRadius: "14px",
                backgroundColor: "#E5E7EB",
                height: "52px",
              },
            }}
          />

          {/* Password */}
          <TextField
            fullWidth
            label="Password"
            type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            error={!!passwordError} // 🔥
            helperText={passwordError} // 🔥
            sx={{
              "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {
                borderRadius: "14px",
                backgroundColor: "#E5E7EB",
                height: "52px",
              },
            }}
            InputProps={{
              endAdornment: (
                <InputAdornment position="end">
                  <IconButton onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}>
                    {showPassword ? <VisibilityOff /> : <Visibility />}
                  </IconButton>
                </InputAdornment>
              ),
            }}
          />

          {/* Login Button */}
          <Button
            type="submit"
            fullWidth
            disabled={isLoading}
            sx={{
              height: "52px",
              borderRadius: "14px",
              backgroundColor: "#F59E0B",
              fontWeight: 600,
              fontSize: "16px",
              color: "#fff",
              textTransform: "none",
              "&:hover": {
                backgroundColor: "#D97706",
              },
            }}
          >
            {isLoading ? "Logging in..." : "Login"}
          </Button>

          {/* Forgot Password */}
          <Box textAlign="right">
            <Typography
              sx={{
                fontSize: "14px",
                color: "#2563EB",
                cursor: "pointer",
                fontWeight: 500,
              }}
              onClick={() => navigate("/forgot-password")}
            >
              Forgot Password?
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};
```

```javascript
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   HELPERS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function fmtDateIST(iso) {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return d.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
    weekday: "short",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: true,
  });
}
function getEntryGroup(entry) {
  const lookupKey = entry.stage?.toLowerCase().startsWith("interview_")
    ? "interview_scheduled"
    : entry.type?.toLowerCase();
  return STAGE_GROUP[lookupKey] ?? null;
}
function groupState(groupKey, grouped, currentStage, hasRejected) {
  const groupEntries = grouped[groupKey] ?? [];
  if (!groupEntries.length) return "pending";

  const hasFailed = groupEntries.some((e) => e.type === "offer_revoked");
  if (hasFailed) return "failed";

  const groupKeys = STAGE_CONFIG.map((s) => s.key);
  const curGroup = STAGE_GROUP[currentStage?.toLowerCase()] ?? "";
  const curIdx = groupKeys.indexOf(curGroup);
  const thisIdx = groupKeys.indexOf(groupKey);

  const groupsWithEntries = groupKeys.filter((gk) => grouped[gk]?.length);
  const lastGroupWithEntries = groupsWithEntries[groupsWithEntries.length - 1];
  const lastIdx = groupKeys.indexOf(lastGroupWithEntries);

  if (hasRejected && thisIdx === lastIdx) return "failed";

  if (curIdx !== -1) {
    if (thisIdx < curIdx) return "completed";
    if (thisIdx === curIdx) return "current";
    return "pending";
  }

  if (thisIdx < lastIdx) return "completed";
  if (thisIdx === lastIdx) return "current";
  return "pending";
}

function normalizeInterviewStatus(rawStatus) {
  if (!rawStatus) return "scheduled";
  const key = rawStatus.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "_");
  return key === "rescheduled" ? "scheduled" : key;
}

// Normalizes whatever the backend sends for a round's outcome ("pass",
// "Pass", "PASSED", etc.) down to "pass" | "fail" | null.
function normalizeInterviewResult(rawResult) {
  if (!rawResult) return null;
  const key = rawResult.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (key.startsWith("pass")) return "pass";
  if (key.startsWith("fail")) return "fail";
  return null;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   INTERVIEW DETAILS MODAL — redesigned
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function formatInterviewDateTime(date, startTime, endTime, duration) {
  if (!date) return { dateLabel: "—", timeLabel: "—" };

  const startHHmm = startTime ? startTime.slice(0, 5) : null;
  const endHHmm = endTime ? endTime.slice(0, 5) : null;

  // date + start_time/end_time are stored in UTC (see basePayload —
  // start.utc().format(...)), so parse as UTC and convert to local before
  // displaying — otherwise the raw UTC clock time renders as if it were
  // already local (e.g. an 11:40 IST interview showed as "06:10").
  const startLocal = startHHmm
    ? dayjs.utc(`${date} ${startHHmm}`, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm").local()
    : null;
  const endLocal = endHHmm
    ? dayjs.utc(`${date} ${endHHmm}`, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm").local()
    : null;

  const dateLabel =
    startLocal && startLocal.isValid()
      ? startLocal.format("dddd, MMMM D, YYYY")
      : dayjs(date).isValid()
        ? dayjs(date).format("dddd, MMMM D, YYYY")
        : "—";

  const start = startLocal && startLocal.isValid() ? startLocal.format("hh:mm A") : "—";
  const end = endLocal && endLocal.isValid() ? endLocal.format("hh:mm A") : "—";
  const timeLabel = `${start} → ${end}${duration ? ` (${duration} mins)` : ""}`;
  return { dateLabel, timeLabel };
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   INTERVIEW FEEDBACK MODAL — view-only, per-interviewer
   Feedback API returns dynamically-keyed interviewer ids
   (e.g. "interviewer_id- 1") and nested feedback arrays.
   Interviewer names + skill buckets aren't in that payload,
   so we cross-reference them from the full interview details
   object (primary_interviewer_org_emp / panel_members_org_emp_ids
   / template.skills) that's fetched alongside it.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const AVATAR_COLORS = ["#2563EB", "#7C3AED", "#16A34A", "#F97316", "#DB2777", "#0891B2"];

function extractInterviewerId(item) {
  const key = Object.keys(item).find((k) => k.startsWith("interviewer_id"));
  return key ? item[key] : null;
}

// Tries every id field shape we've seen on interviewer/panel objects.
function matchesInterviewerId(candidate, id) {
  if (!candidate || !id) return false;
  return (
    candidate.id === id ||
    candidate.org_employee_id === id ||
    candidate.employee_id === id ||
    candidate.primary_interviewer_org_emp === id
  );
}

function resolveInterviewerName(id, interview, fallbackIndex) {
  if (!interview) return `Interviewer ${fallbackIndex + 1}`;

  if (
    matchesInterviewerId(interview.primary_interviewer_org_emp, id) ||
    interview.org_employee_id === id
  ) {
    return interview.primary_interviewer_org_emp?.interviewer_full_name
      ?? `Interviewer ${fallbackIndex + 1}`;
  }

  const panelMatch = (interview.panel_members_org_emp_ids ?? []).find((p) =>
    matchesInterviewerId(p, id),
  );
  if (panelMatch) return panelMatch.interviewer_full_name ?? `Interviewer ${fallbackIndex + 1}`;

  return `Interviewer ${fallbackIndex + 1}`;
}

// Builds { "technical specification documents": "mandatory", ... } from
// interview.template.skills so feedback rows can show the right badge.
function buildSkillBucketMap(templateSkills) {
  const map = {};
  Object.entries(templateSkills ?? {}).forEach(([bucket, labels]) => {
    (labels ?? []).forEach((label) => {
      map[label.trim().toLowerCase()] = bucket;
    });
  });
  return map;
}

function FeedbackRatingBadge({ rating }) {
  const color = rating >= 4 ? "#16A34A" : rating >= 3 ? "#F97316" : "#DC2626";
  const bg = rating >= 4 ? "#EAF8EE" : rating >= 3 ? "#FFF3E8" : "#FEECEC";
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        px: 1.25, py: "3px", borderRadius: "999px",
        bgcolor: bg, color, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, flexShrink: 0,
      }}
    >
      {rating}/5
    </Box>
  );
}

function InterviewFeedbackModal({ open, onClose, interview, feedbackItems, isFetching }) {
  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) setSelectedIdx(0);
  }, [open]);

  const skillBucketMap = useMemo(
    () => buildSkillBucketMap(interview?.template?.skills),
    [interview],
  );

  const panelists = useMemo(() => {
    return (feedbackItems ?? []).map((item, i) => {
      const interviewerId = extractInterviewerId(item);
      const name = resolveInterviewerName(interviewerId, interview, i);
      const ratings = (item.feedback ?? []).flat().filter(Boolean);
      return {
        interviewerId,
        name,
        ratings,
        comments: item.feedback_comments ?? "",
        done: ratings.length > 0,
      };
    });
  }, [feedbackItems, interview]);

  const current = panelists[selectedIdx];
  const loading = isFetching || !feedbackItems;

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      maxWidth={false}
      sx={{ "& .MuiDialog-paper": { width: { xs: "100%", sm: 580, md: 600, lg: 800 } } }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <Box sx={{ px: 3, pt: 2.5, pb: 2, position: "relative" }}>
        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: "#6366F1", letterSpacing: "0.08em" }}>
          EVALUATION PANEL
        </Typography>
        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800, color: "#111827", mt: "2px" }}>
          Interview Feedback
        </Typography>
        <IconButton
          size="small"
          onClick={onClose}
          sx={{
            position: "absolute", top: 18, right: 18,
            width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: "50%", backgroundColor: "#EEF2FF",
          }}
        >
          <CloseIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: "#4B5563" }} />
        </IconButton>
      </Box>

      {/* Interviewer tabs */}
      {!loading && panelists.length > 0 && (
        <Box sx={{ px: 3, display: "flex", gap: 3, borderBottom: `1px solid ${C.border}`, overflowX: "auto" }}>
          {panelists.map((p, i) => {
            const isSelected = i === selectedIdx;
            const color = AVATAR_COLORS[i % AVATAR_COLORS.length];
            return (
              <Box
                key={p.interviewerId ?? i}
                onClick={() => setSelectedIdx(i)}
                sx={{
                  display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1, pb: 1.5,
                  cursor: "pointer", flexShrink: 0,
                  borderBottom: isSelected ? `2.5px solid #2563EB` : "2.5px solid transparent",
                }}
              >
                <Avatar sx={{ width: 26, height: 26, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: isSelected ? color : "#E5E7EB", color: isSelected ? "#fff" : "#6B7280" }}>
                  {p.name?.[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "?"}
                </Avatar>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600, color: isSelected ? "#2563EB" : "#9CA3AF" }}>
                  {p.name}
                </Typography>
                {p.done && (
                  <Chip
                    label="✓ Done"
                    size="small"
                    sx={{ height: 20, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: "#EAF8EE", color: "#16A34A" }}
                  />
                )}
              </Box>
            );
          })}
        </Box>
      )}

      <DialogContent sx={{ p: 0, maxHeight: "65vh", overflowY: "auto" }}>
        {loading ? (
          <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", py: 6 }}>
            <CircularProgress />
          </Box>
        ) : panelists.length === 0 ? (
          <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: "#9CA3AF", textAlign: "center", py: 6 }}>
            No feedback submitted yet.
          </Typography>
        ) : (
          <Box sx={{ px: 3, py: 2.5 }}>
            {/* Selected interviewer row */}
            <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1.5, mb: 2.5 }}>
              <Avatar sx={{ width: 44, height: 44, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, bgcolor: AVATAR_COLORS[selectedIdx % AVATAR_COLORS.length] }}>
                {current?.name?.[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "?"}
              </Avatar>
              <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 700, color: "#111827" }}>
                {current?.name}
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            {/* Skill ratings */}
            <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 1.5, mb: 2.5 }}>
              {(current?.ratings ?? []).map((r, i) => {
                const bucket = skillBucketMap[r.skill?.trim().toLowerCase()];
                const bucketStyle = bucket ? SKILL_GROUP_STYLE[bucket] : null;
                return (
                  <Box
                    key={`${r.skill}-${i}`}
                    sx={{ border: `1px solid ${C.border}`, borderRadius: "12px", p: 1.75 }}
                  >
                    <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 1, mb: 0.75 }}>
                      <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, color: "#111827" }}>
                          {r.skill}
                        </Typography>
                        {bucketStyle && (
                          <Chip
                            label={bucketStyle.label}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                              height: 20, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700,
                              bgcolor: bucketStyle.bg, color: bucketStyle.color,
                            }}
                          />
                        )}
                      </Box>
                      <FeedbackRatingBadge rating={r.rating} />
                    </Box>
                    <Rating value={r.rating} precision={0.5} readOnly size="small" />
                    {r.feedback && (
                      <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: "#6B7280", mt: 0.75 }}>
                        {r.feedback}
                      </Typography>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                );
              })}
            </Box>

            {/* Overall comment */}
            <Box>
              <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: "#2563EB", letterSpacing: "0.06em", mb: 1 }}>
                OVERALL COMMENT
              </Typography>
              <Box
                sx={{
                  border: `1px solid ${C.border}`, borderRadius: "12px",
                  borderLeft: "3px solid #2563EB", p: 1.75, backgroundColor: "#F8FAFF",
                }}
              >
                <Typography
                  sx={{
                    fontSize: 13.5,
                    color: current?.comments ? "#374151" : "#9CA3AF",
                    fontStyle: current?.comments ? "normal" : "italic",
                  }}
                >
                  {current?.comments || "No overall comment provided."}
                </Typography>
              </Box>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        )}
      </DialogContent>

      <DialogActions sx={{ px: 3, py: 2, borderTop: `1px solid ${C.border}` }}>
        <Button
          onClick={onClose}
          variant="outlined"
          sx={{ textTransform: "none", borderRadius: "10px", color: "#111827", borderColor: "#E5E7EB", px: 3 }}
        >
          Close
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

const INTERVIEW_STAGE_STATUSES = [
  "shortlisted",
  "interview_scheduled",
  "interview_completed",
  "interviewing",
];

function CandidateActionButtons({
  status,
  onShortlist,
  onReject,
  onInterview,
  onSelect,
  onReleaseOffer,
  onRevokeOffer,
  onOfferAccepted,
  onOfferRejected,
}) {
  const normalized = (status ?? "").toLowerCase().trim();

  // ── Shortlisted / interviewing stage: Interview, Select (blue), Reject ──
  // Shortlisted -> only Interview + Reject
  if (normalized === "shortlisted") {
    return (
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<PersonAddAltOutlinedIcon />}
          onClick={onInterview}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#16A34A",
          }}
        >
          Interview
        </Button>

        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<BlockOutlinedIcon />}
          onClick={onReject}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#EF4444",
          }}
        >
          Reject
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  // After interview is scheduled/completed -> Interview + Select + Reject
  if (
    [
      "interview_scheduled",
      "interview_completed",
      "interviewing",
    ].includes(normalized)
  ) {
    return (
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<PersonAddAltOutlinedIcon />}
          onClick={onInterview}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#16A34A",
          }}
        >
          Interview
        </Button>

        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<CheckCircleOutlineOutlined />}
          onClick={onSelect}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#2563EB",
          }}
        >
          Select
        </Button>

        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<BlockOutlinedIcon />}
          onClick={onReject}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#EF4444",
          }}
        >
          Reject
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  // ── Matched: Shortlist / Reject ──
  if (normalized === "matched") {
    return (
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<CheckCircleOutlineOutlined sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
          onClick={onShortlist}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 13,
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#B8860B",
            boxShadow: "none",
            px: 2,
            "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#9A6F09", boxShadow: "none" },
          }}
        >
          Shortlist
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<BlockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
          onClick={onReject}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 13,
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#EF4444",
            boxShadow: "none",
            px: 2,
            "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#DC2626", boxShadow: "none" },
          }}
        >
          Reject
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  // ── Selected: Release Offer ──
  if (normalized === "selected") {
    return (
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<LocalOfferOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
          onClick={onReleaseOffer}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 13,
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#2563EB",
            boxShadow: "none",
            px: 2,
            "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#1D4ED8", boxShadow: "none" },
          }}
        >
          Release Offer
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<BlockOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
          onClick={onReject}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 13,
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#EF4444",
            boxShadow: "none",
            px: 2,
            "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#DC2626", boxShadow: "none" },
          }}
        >
          Reject
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  // ── Offer Released: Revoke Offer (orange) / Offer Accepted (green) / Offer Rejected (red) ──
  if (normalized === "offer_released") {
    return (
      <Stack direction="row" spacing={1}>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<UndoOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
          onClick={onRevokeOffer}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 13,
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#F97316",
            boxShadow: "none",
            px: 2,
            "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#EA580C", boxShadow: "none" },
          }}
        >
          Revoke Offer
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<ThumbUpAltOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
          onClick={onOfferAccepted}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 13,
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#16A34A",
            boxShadow: "none",
            px: 2,
            "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#15803D", boxShadow: "none" },
          }}
        >
          Offer Accepted
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="contained"
          size="small"
          startIcon={<ThumbDownAltOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
          onClick={onOfferRejected}
          sx={{
            textTransform: "none",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: 13,
            borderRadius: "8px",
            backgroundColor: "#EF4444",
            boxShadow: "none",
            px: 2,
            "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#DC2626", boxShadow: "none" },
          }}
        >
          Offer Rejected
        </Button>
      </Stack>
    );
  }

  return null;
}
```
