```javascript
function getStrength(password) {
  let score = 0;

  if (password.length >= 8) score++;
  if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) score++;
  if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) score++;
  if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) score++;

  return score;
}

          {/* Current Password */}
          <PasswordField
            label="Current Password"
            value={oldPw}
            setValue={setOldPw}
            show={showOld}
            setShow={setShowOld}
            placeholder="Enter current password"
          />

          {/* New Password */}
          <PasswordField
            label="New Password"
            value={newPw}
            setValue={setNewPw}
            show={showNew}
            setShow={setShowNew}
            placeholder="Enter new password"
          />

          {/* Strength */}
          {newPw.length > 0 && (
            <div className="strength-wrap">
              <div className="strength-bars">
                {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
                  <div
                    key={i}
                    className="strength-bar"
                    style={{
                      background:
                        i <= strength
                          ? strengthColor[
                              strength
                            ]
                          : "#e5e7eb",
                    }}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>

              <div
                className="strength-text"
                style={{
                  color:
                    strengthColor[
                      strength
                    ],
                }}
              >
                {
                  strengthLabel[
                    strength
                  ]
                }
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Confirm Password */}
          <PasswordField
            label="Confirm Password"
            value={confirmPw}
            setValue={setConfirmPw}
            show={showConfirm}
            setShow={setShowConfirm}
            placeholder="Confirm new password"
            borderColor={
              mismatch
                ? "#ef4444"
                : match
                  ? "#22c55e"
                  : undefined
            }
          />

          {mismatch && (
            <div
              className="match-text"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
            >
              Passwords do not match
            </div>
          )}

          {match && (
            <div
              className="match-text"
              style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}
            >
              ✓ Passwords match
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="cp-actions">
            <button
              className="cancel-btn"
              onClick={() =>
                navigate(
                  "/account-manager/settings"
                )
              }
            >
              Cancel
            </button>

            <button
              className="submit-btn"
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              {isLoading
                ? "Updating..."
                : "Update Password"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ChangePasswordPage;
```

```javascript
/* ─── Password strength helper ─── */
function getStrength(pw) {
  let score = 0;
  if (pw.length >= 8) score++;
  if (/[A-Z]/.test(pw)) score++;
  if (/[0-9]/.test(pw)) score++;
  if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(pw)) score++;
  return score; // 0-4
}
const strengthLabel = ["", "Weak", "Fair", "Good", "Strong"];
const strengthColor = ["", "#ef4444", "#f59e0b", "#3b82f6", "#22c55e"];

    if (newPw !== confirmPw) { setError("Passwords do not match."); return; }

    setError("");
    setSubmitted(true);
  };

                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, marginTop: 4, color: strengthColor[strength], fontFamily: "sans-serif", fontWeight: 600 }}>

          </div>

            <div className="input-wrap" style={{ borderColor: mismatch ? "#ef4444" : match ? "#22c55e" : undefined }}>
              <svg className="input-icon" width="16" height="16" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2" stroke="#999" strokeWidth="1.8" /><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4" stroke="#999" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
              <input

                onChange={e => setConfirmPw(e.target.value)}
              />
              <button className="eye-btn" onClick={() => setShowConfirm(v => !v)} tabIndex={-1}>
                {showConfirm
                  ? <svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24" stroke="#999" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" /><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23" stroke="#999" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>

              </button>
            </div>
            {mismatch && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#ef4444", marginTop: 5, fontFamily: "sans-serif" }}>Passwords do not match</div>}
            {match && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#22c55e", marginTop: 5, fontFamily: "sans-serif" }}>✓ Passwords match</div>}
          </div>
          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="cp-actions">
            <button className="cancel-btn" onClick={onBack}>Cancel</button>
            <button className="submit-btn" onClick={handleSubmit}>Update Password</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
```

```javascript
      email,
      password,
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { TextField, Button, Typography, Box, Stack } from "@mui/material";
import { useSignupVerifyOTPMutation } from "../../redux/services/auth/auth";
import { toast } from "react-toastify";
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { AC_ACCESS_TOKEN, AC_REFRESH_TOKEN, setItem } from "../../utils/constants";
const VerifySignupOTP = () => {
  const { state } = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const emailFromState = state?.email || "";
  // ✅ correct hook
  const [signupVerifyOTP, { isLoading }] = useSignupVerifyOTPMutation();
  const inputs = useRef([]);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(emailFromState);
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState(["", "", "", "", "", ""]);
  // OTP handler
  const handleOtpChange = (value, index) => {
    if (!/^[0-9]?$/.test(value)) return;
    const newOtp = [...otp];
    newOtp[index] = value;
    setOtp(newOtp);
    if (value && index < 5) {
      inputs.current[index + 1]?.focus();
    }
  };
  // Submit
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const handleVerify = async () => {
    if (isSubmitting) return; 
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    const otpValue = otp.join("");
    if (!email || otpValue.length !== 6) {
      toast.error("Enter valid email and Otp ");
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await signupVerifyOTP({
        email,
        otp: otpValue,
      }).unwrap();
      if (res?.success) {
        toast.success(res.message || "Verified successfully");
        setItem(AC_ACCESS_TOKEN, res.data.access_token);
        setItem(AC_REFRESH_TOKEN, res.data.refresh_token);
        navigate("/account-manager/dashboard");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.data?.message || "Verification failed");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (emailFromState) {
      setEmail(emailFromState);
    }
  }, [emailFromState]);
return (
  <Box
    sx={{
      minHeight: "100vh",
      display: "flex",
      justifyContent: "center",
      alignItems: "center",
      background: "#f4f6f8",
    }}
  >
    <Box
      sx={{
        width: "100%",
        maxWidth: 420,
        p: 5,
        borderRadius: "28px",
        background: "#ffffff",
        boxShadow: "0px 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",
      }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <Box textAlign="center" mb={3}>
        <Typography fontSize="28px" fontWeight={700}>
          Verify OTP
        </Typography>
        <Typography fontSize="14px" color="#8E8E8E" mt={1}>
          Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      <Stack spacing={2.5}>
        {/* Email */}
        <TextField
          fullWidth
          label="Email"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          sx={{
            "& .MuiOutlinedInput-root": {
              borderRadius: "14px",
              backgroundColor: "#fafafa",
              height: "52px",
            },
          }}
        />

        {/* OTP BOXES */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            gap: 1,
          }}
        >
          {otp.map((digit, index) => (
            <input
              key={index}
              ref={(el) => (inputs.current[index] = el)}
              value={digit}
              onChange={(e) => handleOtpChange(e.target.value, index)}
              maxLength={1}
              style={{
                width: "52px",
                height: "58px",
                textAlign: "center",
                fontSize: "20px",
                borderRadius: "14px",
                border: "1px solid #e0e0e0",
                background: "#fafafa",
                outline: "none",
                transition: "0.2s",
              }}
              onFocus={(e) => (e.target.style.border = "1.5px solid #FE9F43")}
              onBlur={(e) => (e.target.style.border = "1px solid #e0e0e0")}
            />
          ))}
        </Box>

        {/* Verify Button */}
        <Button
          fullWidth
          onClick={handleVerify}
          disabled={isLoading || isSubmitting}
          sx={{
            height: "52px",
            background: "#FE9F43",
            borderRadius: "14px",
            fontWeight: 600,
            fontSize: "16px",
            textTransform: "none",
            color: "#fff",
            mt: 1,
            "&:hover": {
              background: "#f78b1f",
            },
          }}
        >
          {isLoading ? "Verifying..." : "Verify OTP"}
        </Button>

        {/* Resend */}
        <Typography
          textAlign="center"
          fontSize="13px"
          color="#8E8E8E"
        >
          Didn’t receive code?{" "}
          <span
            style={{
              color: "#FE9F43",
              fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: "pointer",
            }}
          >
            Resend
          </span>
        </Typography>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </Box>
);
};
export default VerifySignupOTP;
```

```javascript
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  Alert, Box, Button, Card, CardContent, Chip, CircularProgress, Dialog,
  DialogActions, DialogContent, DialogTitle, Divider, IconButton, Menu,
  MenuItem, Stack, Tab, Tabs, TextField, Typography,
} from "@mui/material";
import {
  CalendarMonth, Cancel, CheckCircle, GridView, Groups, MoreVert, Replay,
  ViewList,
} from "@mui/icons-material";
import ReusableMRT from "../../components/table";
import {
  useCancelOrganisationSubscriptionMutation,
  useExtendOrganisationTrialMutation,
  useGetOrganisationSubscriptionsQuery,
  useReinitiateOrganisationTrialMutation,
  useResumeOrganisationSubscriptionMutation,
  useUpgradeOrganisationToPaygMutation,
} from "../../redux/services/subscriptions/subscriptions";

const PRIMARY_COLOR = "#FF5722";
const TRIAL_COLOR = "#6D4AFF";
const PAYG_COLOR = "#087E8B";
const formatDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "—";
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? value : new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric",
  }).format(date);
};
const formatLabel = (value) => value
  ? value.replaceAll("_", " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase())
  : "—";
const formatSubscriptionStatus = (value) => formatLabel(value).replace(/\bPayg\b/gi, "Premium");
const formatPlanName = (value) => String(value || "").toLowerCase() === "payg"
  ? "Premium"
  : formatLabel(value);
const isCancelledSubscription = (subscription) =>
  [subscription.subscription_status, subscription.status]
    .some((status) => String(status || "").toLowerCase() === "cancelled");
const isTrialSubscription = (subscription) =>
  subscription.is_trial === true || String(subscription.subscription_type || "").toLowerCase() === "trial";
const isPaygSubscription = (subscription) =>
  subscription.is_payg === true || String(subscription.subscription_type || "").toLowerCase() === "payg";
const displayLimit = (value) => value === null || value === undefined ? "Unlimited" : value;
const displayPrice = (value) => value === null || value === undefined
  ? "—"
  : new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN").format(value);

const activationPayload = (subscription) => ({
  organisation_id: subscription.organisation_id,
  max_users: subscription.limits?.max_users ?? 1,
  max_jobs: subscription.limits?.max_jobs ?? 1,
  max_candidate_uploads: subscription.limits?.max_candidate_uploads ?? 1,
  max_matches: subscription.limits?.max_matches ?? 0,
  max_candidates_per_job: subscription.limits?.max_candidates_per_job ?? 1,
  price_per_user: subscription.pricing?.price_per_user ?? 0,
  price_per_job: subscription.pricing?.price_per_job ?? 0,
  price_per_interview: subscription.pricing?.price_per_interview ?? 0,
  price_per_upload: subscription.pricing?.price_per_upload ?? 0,
  price_per_skill_intel_profile: subscription.pricing?.price_per_skill_intel_profile ?? 0,
  price_per_background_verification: subscription.pricing?.price_per_background_verification ?? 0,
  success_fee_percent: subscription.pricing?.success_fee_percent ?? 100,
  // billing_day: subscription.billing_day ?? 1,
});

const StatusChip = ({ subscription }) => {
  const status = subscription.subscription_status || subscription.status;
  const active = subscription.is_active ?? String(status || "").toLowerCase() === "active";
  return (
    <Chip
      size="small"
      label={formatSubscriptionStatus(status)}
      icon={active ? <CheckCircle sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} /> : <Cancel sx={{ fontSize: 15 }} />}
      sx={{
        fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "12px",
        backgroundColor: active ? "#E9F8EF" : "#F3F4F6",
        color: active ? "#15803D" : "#6B7280",
        "& .MuiChip-icon": { color: "inherit" },
      }}
    />
  );
};

const PlanChip = ({ subscription }) => {
  const trial = isTrialSubscription(subscription);
  const color = trial ? TRIAL_COLOR : PAYG_COLOR;
  return (
    <Chip
      size="small"
      label={formatPlanName(subscription.subscription_type || (trial ? "trial" : "payg"))}
      sx={{
        fontWeight: 700,
        color,
        backgroundColor: trial ? "#F1EDFF" : "#E7F6F7",
        borderRadius: "7px",
      }}
    />
  );
};

const Detail = ({ label, value, icon }) => (
  <Box>
    <Typography fontSize="11px" color="#9CA3AF" sx={{ mb: 0.4 }}>{label}</Typography>
    <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 0.5 }}>
      {icon && <Box sx={{ color: PRIMARY_COLOR, display: "flex", "& svg": { fontSize: 15 } }}>{icon}</Box>}
      <Typography fontSize="13px" fontWeight={600} color="#374151">{value}</Typography>
    </Box>
  </Box>
);

const EmptyState = () => (
  <Box sx={{ height: "70%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", flexDirection: "column", color: "#9CA3AF" }}>
    <Cancel sx={{ fontSize: 42, mb: 1, color: "#D1D5DB" }} />
    <Typography fontSize="14px">No subscriptions found</Typography>
  </Box>
);

const SubscriptionActions = ({ subscription, onUpgrade, onCancel, onReinitiate, onResume, onExtendTrial, onViewUsage }) => {
  const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState(null);
  const closeMenu = () => setAnchorEl(null);
  const runAction = (action) => {
    closeMenu();
    action();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <IconButton
        size="small"
        aria-label={`Actions for ${subscription.organisation_name || "organisation"}`}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        onClick={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          setAnchorEl(event.currentTarget);
        }}
        sx={{ border: "1px solid #E5E7EB", borderRadius: 1.5, color: "#4B5563" }}
      >
        <MoreVert fontSize="small" />
      </IconButton>
      <Menu
        anchorEl={anchorEl}
        open={Boolean(anchorEl)}
        onClose={closeMenu}
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "right" }}
        transformOrigin={{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" }}
      >
        {subscription.is_active && (
          <MenuItem onClick={() => runAction(onViewUsage)}>View usage</MenuItem>
        )}
        <MenuItem onClick={() => runAction(onUpgrade)}>Upgrade plan</MenuItem>
        {isTrialSubscription(subscription) && !isCancelledSubscription(subscription) && (
          <MenuItem onClick={() => runAction(onExtendTrial)}>Extend trial</MenuItem>
        )}
        {isTrialSubscription(subscription) && !subscription.is_active && !isCancelledSubscription(subscription) && (
          <MenuItem onClick={() => runAction(onReinitiate)}>Reinitiate trial</MenuItem>
        )}
        {isCancelledSubscription(subscription) && (
          <MenuItem onClick={() => runAction(onResume)} sx={{ color: "#15803D" }}>
            Resume subscription
          </MenuItem>
        )}
        {subscription.is_active && (
          <MenuItem onClick={() => runAction(onCancel)} sx={{ color: "#DC2626" }}>
            {isTrialSubscription(subscription) ? "Cancel Trial" : "Cancel Subscription"}
          </MenuItem>
        )}
      </Menu>
    </>
  );
};

const SubscriptionCard = ({ subscription, onActivate, onCancel, onReinitiate, onResume, onExtendTrial }) => {
  const isTrial = isTrialSubscription(subscription);
  const dateLabel = isTrial ? "Trial ends" : "Premium started";
  const dateValue = isTrial ? subscription.trial_ends_at : subscription.payg_started_at;
  return (
    <Card sx={{ borderRadius: "14px", border: "1px solid #E5E7EB", borderTop: `3px solid ${isTrial ? TRIAL_COLOR : PAYG_COLOR}`, boxShadow: "none", backgroundColor: "#fff" }}>
      <CardContent sx={{ p: 2.2 }}>
        <Box sx={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", mb: 2, gap: 1 }}>
          <Box>
            <Typography fontSize="15px" fontWeight={700} color="#1F2937">{subscription.organisation_name || "Organisation"}</Typography>
            <Box sx={{ mt: 0.6 }}><PlanChip subscription={subscription} /></Box>
          </Box>
          <StatusChip subscription={subscription} />
        </Box>
        <Divider sx={{ mb: 2 }} />
        <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 1.8 }}>
          <Detail label="Started" value={formatDate(subscription.started_at)} icon={<CalendarMonth />} />
          <Detail label={dateLabel} value={formatDate(dateValue)} icon={<CalendarMonth />} />
          <Detail label="User limit" value={displayLimit(subscription.limits?.max_users)} icon={<Groups />} />
          <Detail label="Job limit" value={displayLimit(subscription.limits?.max_jobs)} />
          <Detail label="Candidate uploads" value={displayLimit(subscription.limits?.max_candidate_uploads)} />
          {/* <Detail label="Billing day" value={subscription.billing_day ? "Day " + subscription.billing_day : "—"} /> */}
          {isPaygSubscription(subscription) && <Detail label="Price per user" value={displayPrice(subscription.pricing?.price_per_user)} />}
        </Box>
        {isTrial && subscription.trial_days_remaining !== null && (
          <Typography fontSize="12px" color={TRIAL_COLOR} fontWeight={600} sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
            {subscription.trial_days_remaining} day{subscription.trial_days_remaining === 1 ? "" : "s"} remaining
          </Typography>
        )}
        {subscription.is_active ? (
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ mt: 2, flexWrap: "wrap", rowGap: 1 }}>
            <Button size="small" variant="contained" onClick={() => onActivate(subscription)} sx={{ backgroundColor: PRIMARY_COLOR }}>
              Upgrade Plan
            </Button>
            <Button size="small" variant="outlined" color="error" onClick={() => onCancel(subscription)}>
              {isTrial ? "Cancel Trial" : "Cancel Subscription"}
            </Button>
            {isTrial && !isCancelledSubscription(subscription) && (
              <Button size="small" variant="outlined" onClick={() => onExtendTrial(subscription)} sx={{ color: TRIAL_COLOR, borderColor: TRIAL_COLOR }}>
                Extend Trial
              </Button>
            )}
          </Stack>
        ) : (
          <Stack direction="row" spacing={1} sx={{ mt: 2, flexWrap: "wrap", rowGap: 1 }}>
            <Button size="small" variant="contained" onClick={() => onActivate(subscription)} sx={{ backgroundColor: PRIMARY_COLOR }}>
              Upgrade Plan
            </Button>
            {isCancelledSubscription(subscription) && (
              <Button size="small" variant="outlined" onClick={() => onResume(subscription)} sx={{ color: "#15803D", borderColor: "#15803D" }}>
                Resume Subscription
              </Button>
            )}
            {isTrialSubscription(subscription) && !isCancelledSubscription(subscription) && (
              <Button size="small" variant="outlined" onClick={() => onReinitiate(subscription)} sx={{ color: PRIMARY_COLOR, borderColor: PRIMARY_COLOR }}>
                Reinitiate Trial
              </Button>
            )}
            {isTrialSubscription(subscription) && !isCancelledSubscription(subscription) && (
              <Button size="small" variant="outlined" onClick={() => onExtendTrial(subscription)} sx={{ color: TRIAL_COLOR, borderColor: TRIAL_COLOR }}>
                Extend Trial
              </Button>
            )}
          </Stack>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
};

const toggleSx = (selected) => ({
  width: 38, height: 34, borderRadius: "7px",
  backgroundColor: selected ? PRIMARY_COLOR : "transparent",
  color: selected ? "#fff" : "#6B7280",
  "&:hover": { backgroundColor: selected ? PRIMARY_COLOR : "#E5E7EB" },
});
const PlanTabLabel = ({ title, description, count }) => (
  <Box sx={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "flex-start", lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
    <Box sx={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 0.75 }}>
      <Typography component="span" fontSize="13px" fontWeight={700}>{title}</Typography>
      <Typography component="span" fontSize="11px" fontWeight={700} sx={{ opacity: 0.8 }}>{count}</Typography>
    </Box>
    <Typography component="span" fontSize="10px" sx={{ mt: 0.35, opacity: 0.78 }}>{description}</Typography>
  </Box>
);

const PAYG_FIELDS = [
  ["max_users", "Maximum users"],
  ["max_jobs", "Maximum jobs"],
  ["max_candidate_uploads", "Maximum candidate uploads"],
  ["max_matches", "Maximum matches"],
  ["max_candidates_per_job", "Maximum candidates per job"],
  ["price_per_user", "Price per user"],
  ["price_per_job", "Price per job"],
  ["price_per_interview", "Price per interview"],
  ["price_per_upload", "Price per upload"],
  ["price_per_skill_intel_profile", "Price per skill intel profile"],
  ["price_per_background_verification", "Price per background verification"],
  ["success_fee_percent", "Success fee percent"],
  // ["billing_day", "Billing day"],
];

const UpgradePaygDialog = ({ subscription, onClose }) => {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => activationPayload(subscription));
  const [upgradeOrganisationToPayg, { isLoading, error }] = useUpgradeOrganisationToPaygMutation();
  const updateField = (field, value) => setForm((current) => ({
    ...current,
    [field]: Number(value),
  }));
  const activate = async () => {
    try {
      await upgradeOrganisationToPayg(form).unwrap();
      onClose();
    } catch {
      // The API error is rendered below the form.
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open onClose={isLoading ? undefined : onClose} maxWidth="md" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle>Upgrade Plan</DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent dividers>
        <Typography fontSize="14px" color="#6B7280" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
          This will upgrade {subscription.organisation_name || "organisation"} to the selected plan with the limits and prices below.
        </Typography>
        <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
          {PAYG_FIELDS.map(([field, label]) => (
            <TextField
              key={field}
              label={label}
              type="number"
              value={form[field]}
              onChange={(event) => updateField(field, event.target.value)}
              fullWidth
              size="small"
              slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 0 } }}
            />
          ))}
        </Box>
        {error && <Typography color="error" fontSize="13px" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
          {error?.data?.message || "Unable to upgrade this organisation. Please try again."}
        </Typography>}
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions sx={{ px: 3, py: 2 }}>
        <Button onClick={onClose} disabled={isLoading}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button variant="contained" onClick={activate} disabled={isLoading} sx={{ backgroundColor: PRIMARY_COLOR }}>
          {isLoading ? "Upgrading..." : "Upgrade Plan"}
        </Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};

const Subscriptions = () => {
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState("list");
  const [planTab, setPlanTab] = useState("trial");
  const [subscriptionToActivate, setSubscriptionToActivate] = useState(null);
  const [subscriptionToCancel, setSubscriptionToCancel] = useState(null);
  const [subscriptionToReinitiate, setSubscriptionToReinitiate] = useState(null);
  const [subscriptionToResume, setSubscriptionToResume] = useState(null);
  const [subscriptionToExtendTrial, setSubscriptionToExtendTrial] = useState(null);
  const [extensionDays, setExtensionDays] = useState("1");
  const [cancelError, setCancelError] = useState("");
  const [reinitiateError, setReinitiateError] = useState("");
  const [resumeError, setResumeError] = useState("");
  const [extensionError, setExtensionError] = useState("");
  const [cancelOrganisationSubscription, { isLoading: isCancelling }] = useCancelOrganisationSubscriptionMutation();
  const [reinitiateOrganisationTrial, { isLoading: isReinitiating }] = useReinitiateOrganisationTrialMutation();
  const [resumeOrganisationSubscription, { isLoading: isResuming }] = useResumeOrganisationSubscriptionMutation();
  const [extendOrganisationTrial, { isLoading: isExtendingTrial }] = useExtendOrganisationTrialMutation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: response, isLoading, isFetching, isError, error, refetch } =
    useGetOrganisationSubscriptionsQuery();
  const subscriptions = useMemo(
    () => Array.isArray(response?.data) ? response.data : [],
    [response],
  );
  const planSubscriptions = useMemo(
    () => subscriptions.filter((item) => planTab === "trial" ? isTrialSubscription(item) : isPaygSubscription(item)),
    [subscriptions, planTab],
  );
  const filteredSubscriptions = planSubscriptions;
  const trialCount = subscriptions.filter(isTrialSubscription).length;
  const paygCount = subscriptions.filter(isPaygSubscription).length;
  const confirmCancellation = async () => {
    if (!subscriptionToCancel?.organisation_id) return;
    setCancelError("");
    try {
      await cancelOrganisationSubscription(subscriptionToCancel.organisation_id).unwrap();
      setSubscriptionToCancel(null);
      refetch();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setCancelError(requestError?.data?.message || requestError?.data?.detail || "Unable to cancel this subscription. Please try again.");
    }
  };
  const confirmTrialReinitiation = async () => {
    if (!subscriptionToReinitiate?.organisation_id) return;
    setReinitiateError("");
    try {
      await reinitiateOrganisationTrial(subscriptionToReinitiate.organisation_id).unwrap();
      setSubscriptionToReinitiate(null);
      refetch();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setReinitiateError(requestError?.data?.message || requestError?.data?.detail || "Unable to reinitiate this trial. Please try again.");
    }
  };
  const confirmResume = async () => {
    if (!subscriptionToResume?.organisation_id) return;
    setResumeError("");
    try {
      await resumeOrganisationSubscription(subscriptionToResume.organisation_id).unwrap();
      setSubscriptionToResume(null);
      refetch();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setResumeError(requestError?.data?.message || requestError?.data?.detail || "Unable to resume this subscription. Please try again.");
    }
  };
  const confirmTrialExtension = async () => {
    if (!subscriptionToExtendTrial?.organisation_id) return;
    const days = Number(extensionDays);
    if (!Number.isInteger(days) || days < 1) {
      setExtensionError("Enter a whole number of days greater than zero.");
      return;
    }
    setExtensionError("");
    try {
      await extendOrganisationTrial({
        organisationId: subscriptionToExtendTrial.organisation_id,
        extension_days: days,
      }).unwrap();
      setSubscriptionToExtendTrial(null);
      setExtensionDays("1");
      refetch();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setExtensionError(requestError?.data?.message || requestError?.data?.detail || "Unable to extend this trial. Please try again.");
    }
  };
  const openTrialExtension = (subscription) => {
    setExtensionError("");
    setExtensionDays("1");
    setSubscriptionToExtendTrial(subscription);
  };
  const columns = useMemo(() => [
    { accessorKey: "organisation_name", header: "Organisation", size: 175, cellSx: { minWidth: 130 } },
    { accessorKey: "subscription_type", header: "Plan", size: 110, Cell: ({ row }) => <PlanChip subscription={row.original} /> },
    { accessorKey: "subscription_status", header: "Status", size: 145, Cell: ({ row }) => <StatusChip subscription={row.original} /> },
    { accessorKey: "started_at", header: "Started", size: 125, Cell: ({ cell }) => formatDate(cell.getValue()) },
    { id: "trial_ends_at", header: "Trial ends", size: 125, accessorFn: (row) => row.trial_ends_at, Cell: ({ cell }) => formatDate(cell.getValue()) },
    // { accessorKey: "billing_day", header: "Billing Day", Cell: ({ cell }) => cell.getValue() ? "Day " + cell.getValue() : "—" },
    // { id: "max_users", header: "User Limit", accessorFn: (row) => row.limits?.max_users, Cell: ({ cell }) => displayLimit(cell.getValue()) },
    // { id: "price_per_user", header: "Price per User", accessorFn: (row) => row.pricing?.price_per_user, Cell: ({ cell }) => displayPrice(cell.getValue()) },
    { id: "activate", header: "Actions", size: 84, minSize: 72, maxSize: 92, enableSorting: false, enableColumnFilter: false, Cell: ({ row }) => <SubscriptionActions
      subscription={row.original}
      onViewUsage={() => navigate("/account-manager/org/" + row.original.organisation_id, { state: { activeTab: 5 } })}
      onUpgrade={() => setSubscriptionToActivate(row.original)}
      onCancel={() => { setCancelError(""); setSubscriptionToCancel(row.original); }}
      onReinitiate={() => { setReinitiateError(""); setSubscriptionToReinitiate(row.original); }}
      onResume={() => { setResumeError(""); setSubscriptionToResume(row.original); }}
      onExtendTrial={() => openTrialExtension(row.original)}
    /> },
  ], [navigate]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return <Box sx={{ height: "calc(100vh - 68px)", display: "grid", placeItems: "center" }}><CircularProgress sx={{ color: PRIMARY_COLOR }} /></Box>;
  }
  if (isError) {
    return (
      <Box sx={{ height: "calc(100vh - 68px)", display: "grid", placeItems: "center", textAlign: "center" }}>
        <Box>
          <Typography color="#374151" fontWeight={600}>{error?.data?.message || "Unable to load subscriptions."}</Typography>
          <Button onClick={refetch} startIcon={<Replay />} sx={{ mt: 1, color: PRIMARY_COLOR }}>Try again</Button>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Box sx={{ width: "100%", height: "calc(100vh - 70px)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", backgroundColor: "#fff", overflow: "hidden" }}>
      <Box sx={{ minHeight: { xs: 86, md: 82 }, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 2, flexWrap: "wrap", flexShrink: 0, px: { xs: 1.5, md: 2.5 }, py: 1.25, borderBottom: "1px solid #E5E7EB", backgroundColor: "#FCFCFD" }}>
        <Box>
          <Box>
            <Typography variant="overline" sx={{ display: "block", lineHeight: 1.2, color: "#64748B", fontSize: "10px", fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.08em", mb: 0.65 }}>
              PLAN TYPE
            </Typography>
            <Tabs
              aria-label="Filter by plan type"
              value={planTab}
              onChange={(_, value) => setPlanTab(value)}
              sx={{ minHeight: 48, "& .MuiTabs-indicator": { display: "none" }, "& .MuiTab-root": { minHeight: 46, minWidth: { xs: 142, sm: 158 }, px: 1.4, py: 0.6, alignItems: "flex-start", textTransform: "none", color: "#64748B", border: "1px solid #E2E8F0", borderRadius: "10px", mr: 0.75, backgroundColor: "#fff" }, "& .Mui-selected": { borderColor: (planTab === "trial" ? TRIAL_COLOR : PAYG_COLOR) + " !important", color: (planTab === "trial" ? TRIAL_COLOR : PAYG_COLOR) + " !important", backgroundColor: (planTab === "trial" ? "#F1EDFF" : "#E7F6F7") + " !important" } }}
            >
              <Tab value="trial" label={<PlanTabLabel title="Trial" description="Time-limited access" count={trialCount} />} />
              <Tab value="payg" label={<PlanTabLabel title="Premium" description="Usage-based plan" count={paygCount} />} />
            </Tabs>
          </Box>
        </Box>
        <Stack direction="row" spacing={0.5} sx={{ backgroundColor: "#F3F4F6", borderRadius: "9px", p: 0.4, ml: "auto" }}>
          <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setViewMode("list")} sx={toggleSx(viewMode === "list")}><ViewList fontSize="small" /></IconButton>
          <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => setViewMode("grid")} sx={toggleSx(viewMode === "grid")}><GridView fontSize="small" /></IconButton>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
      <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflow: "hidden", p: { xs: 1, md: 2 } }}>
        {viewMode === "list" ? (
          <ReusableMRT data={filteredSubscriptions} columnData={columns} enableRowActions={false} enableRowClickModal={false} compactMode disableDefaultColumnPinning height="100%" />
        ) : (
          <Box sx={{ height: "100%", overflowY: "auto", pr: 0.5 }}>
            <Box sx={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: { xs: "1fr", sm: "repeat(2, 1fr)", lg: "repeat(3, 1fr)", xl: "repeat(4, 1fr)" }, gap: 2 }}>
              {filteredSubscriptions.map((subscription) => <SubscriptionCard key={subscription.organisation_id} subscription={subscription} onActivate={setSubscriptionToActivate} onCancel={(item) => { setCancelError(""); setSubscriptionToCancel(item); }} onReinitiate={(item) => { setReinitiateError(""); setSubscriptionToReinitiate(item); }} onResume={(item) => { setResumeError(""); setSubscriptionToResume(item); }} onExtendTrial={openTrialExtension} />)}
            </Box>
            {filteredSubscriptions.length === 0 && <EmptyState />}
          </Box>
        )}
        {isFetching && <CircularProgress size={18} sx={{ color: PRIMARY_COLOR, position: "fixed", right: 28, bottom: 28 }} />}
      </Box>
      {subscriptionToActivate && <UpgradePaygDialog key={subscriptionToActivate.organisation_id} subscription={subscriptionToActivate} onClose={() => setSubscriptionToActivate(null)} />}
      <Dialog open={Boolean(subscriptionToCancel)} onClose={isCancelling ? undefined : () => setSubscriptionToCancel(null)} maxWidth="xs" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Cancel {isTrialSubscription(subscriptionToCancel || {}) ? "trial" : "subscription"}?</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent dividers>
          <Typography fontSize="14px" color="#4B5563">
            Cancel the {isTrialSubscription(subscriptionToCancel || {}) ? "trial" : "subscription"} for <strong>{subscriptionToCancel?.organisation_name || "this organisation"}</strong>? This will mark it as cancelled.
          </Typography>
          {cancelError && <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>{cancelError}</Alert>}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions sx={{ px: 3, py: 2 }}>
          <Button onClick={() => setSubscriptionToCancel(null)} disabled={isCancelling}>
            Keep {isTrialSubscription(subscriptionToCancel || {}) ? "trial" : "subscription"}
          </Button>
          <Button color="error" variant="contained" onClick={confirmCancellation} disabled={isCancelling}>
            {isCancelling ? "Cancelling..." : `Cancel ${isTrialSubscription(subscriptionToCancel || {}) ? "Trial" : "Subscription"}`}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
      <Dialog open={Boolean(subscriptionToReinitiate)} onClose={isReinitiating ? undefined : () => setSubscriptionToReinitiate(null)} maxWidth="xs" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Reinitiate trial?</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent dividers>
          <Typography fontSize="14px" color="#4B5563">
            Reinitiate the trial for <strong>{subscriptionToReinitiate?.organisation_name || "this organisation"}</strong>? The subscription will be set back to active with a new trial period.
          </Typography>
          {reinitiateError && <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>{reinitiateError}</Alert>}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions sx={{ px: 3, py: 2 }}>
          <Button onClick={() => setSubscriptionToReinitiate(null)} disabled={isReinitiating}>Keep current status</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={confirmTrialReinitiation} disabled={isReinitiating} sx={{ backgroundColor: PRIMARY_COLOR }}>
            {isReinitiating ? "Reinitiating..." : "Confirm reinitiation"}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
      <Dialog open={Boolean(subscriptionToResume)} onClose={isResuming ? undefined : () => setSubscriptionToResume(null)} maxWidth="xs" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Resume subscription?</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent dividers>
          <Typography fontSize="14px" color="#4B5563">
            Resume the cancelled subscription for <strong>{subscriptionToResume?.organisation_name || "this organisation"}</strong>?
          </Typography>
          {resumeError && <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>{resumeError}</Alert>}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions sx={{ px: 3, py: 2 }}>
          <Button onClick={() => setSubscriptionToResume(null)} disabled={isResuming}>Keep cancelled</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={confirmResume} disabled={isResuming} sx={{ backgroundColor: "#15803D", "&:hover": { backgroundColor: "#166534" } }}>
            {isResuming ? "Resuming..." : "Resume subscription"}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
      <Dialog open={Boolean(subscriptionToExtendTrial)} onClose={isExtendingTrial ? undefined : () => setSubscriptionToExtendTrial(null)} maxWidth="xs" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>Extend trial</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent dividers>
          <Typography fontSize="14px" color="#4B5563" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            Add days to the trial for <strong>{subscriptionToExtendTrial?.organisation_name || "this organisation"}</strong>.
          </Typography>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            fullWidth
            size="small"
            label="Extension days"
            type="number"
            value={extensionDays}
            onChange={(event) => setExtensionDays(event.target.value)}
            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 1, step: 1 } }}
          />
          {extensionError && <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>{extensionError}</Alert>}
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions sx={{ px: 3, py: 2 }}>
          <Button onClick={() => setSubscriptionToExtendTrial(null)} disabled={isExtendingTrial}>Close</Button>
          <Button variant="contained" onClick={confirmTrialExtension} disabled={isExtendingTrial} sx={{ backgroundColor: TRIAL_COLOR }}>
            {isExtendingTrial ? "Extending..." : "Extend Trial"}
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Subscriptions;
```

## File: redux/services/baseQuery/baseQuery.js

```javascript
import { fetchBaseQuery } from "@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react";
import {
  AC_ACCESS_TOKEN,
  AC_REFRESH_TOKEN,
  candidateClearLocalStorage,
  getItem,
  setItem,
} from "../../../utils/constants";

import { toast } from "react-toastify";

const baseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_BASE_URL;
console.log(window.location.origin);
// base query
const rawBaseQuery = fetchBaseQuery({
  baseUrl,
  prepareHeaders: (headers, { endpoint }) => {
    const token = getItem(AC_ACCESS_TOKEN);
    if (endpoint !== "login" && endpoint !== "signup") {
      if (token) {
        headers.set("Authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
      }
    }

    return headers;
  },
});

// custom base query with refresh logic
export const baseQueryWithReauth = async (args, api, extraOptions) => {
  let result = await rawBaseQuery(args, api, extraOptions);

  if (result?.error && [401, 403].includes(result.error.status)) {
    const refresh_token = getItem(AC_REFRESH_TOKEN);

    if (!refresh_token) {
      toast.error("Session expired, please login");
      candidateClearLocalStorage();
      window.location.href = "/login";
      return result;
    }

    // refresh call
    const refreshResult = await rawBaseQuery(
      {
        url: "/acc/account_manager_refresh-access-token",
        method: "POST",
        body: new URLSearchParams({ refresh_token }),
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
        },
      },
      api,
      extraOptions,
    );
    console.log("Refresh result:", refreshResult);
    if (refreshResult?.data) {
      const newAccessToken =
        refreshResult.data?.data?.access_token ||
        refreshResult.data?.access_token ||
        refreshResult.data?.token;

      if (newAccessToken) {
        //  store new token
        setItem(AC_ACCESS_TOKEN, newAccessToken);

        //  retry original request
        result = await rawBaseQuery(args, api, extraOptions);
      } else {
        return refreshResult;
      }
    } else {
      toast.error("Session expired, please login again");
      candidateClearLocalStorage();
      window.location.href = "/login";
      return refreshResult;
    }
  }

  return result;
};

```

```javascript
// dashboardService.js
import { api } from "../api/api";

export const dashboardService = api.injectEndpoints({
    endpoints: (builder) => ({
        getCandidateListByStatus: builder.query({
            query: (status = "") => ({
                url: "/acc/candidate_list_by_status",
                params: { status },
            }),
        }),

        getJobAnalytics: builder.query({
            query: ({
                groupBy = "month",
                periodCount = 6,
                status = "all",
                scope = "user",
                countsType = "cumulative",
                filterBySubfunction = "",   // empty = All
                country = "all",
            } = {}) => {
                const isAllTime = periodCount === "all";
                return {
                    url: "/acc/organisations/job-analytics_v2",
                    params: {
                        group_by: groupBy,
                        status,
                        scope,
                        counts_type: countsType,
                        all_time: isAllTime,
                        ...(isAllTime ? {} : { period_count: periodCount }),
                        country,
                        ...(filterBySubfunction ? { filter_by_subfunction: filterBySubfunction } : {}),
                    },
                };
            },
        }),

        getStageDetails: builder.query({
            query: ({
                stage, period = "", status = "all", scope = "user",
                countsType = "cumulative", filterBySubfunction = "",
                country = "all", page = 1, pageSize = 50,
            }) => ({
                url: "/acc/analytics/jobs/stage-details",
                params: {
                    stage, period, status, scope,
                    counts_type: countsType,
                    country,
                    ...(filterBySubfunction ? { filter_by_subfunction: filterBySubfunction } : {}),
                    page, page_size: pageSize,
                },
            }),
            // Stage dialogs are often reopened while reviewing candidates.
            // Keep their paginated results in the Redux RTK Query cache so
            // reopening a stage is immediate instead of making another call.
            keepUnusedDataFor: 300,
        }),

        getJobsList: builder.query({
            query: ({
                status = "all",
                country = "all",
                filterBySubfunction = "all",
                periodCount,   // 3 | 6 | "all"/undefined = leave empty (all time)
            } = {}) => ({
                url: "/acc/get_jobs_list_v1",
                params: {
                    status,
                    country,
                    // The sub-function filter key is underscored (e.g. "clinical_data_manager"),
                    // but this endpoint expects it space-separated (e.g. "clinical data manager").
                    sub_function: filterBySubfunction ? filterBySubfunction.replace(/_/g, " ") : "all",
                    ...(periodCount === 3 || periodCount === 6 ? { period: periodCount } : {}),
                },
            }),
        }),

        // ── org-wide stage drill-down — now filter-aware ─────────────────────
        // getStageDetails: builder.query({
        //     query: ({
        //         stage,
        //         period = "",
        //         status = "all",
        //         scope = "user",
        //         countsType = "cumulative",
        //         domain = "all",
        //         function: fn = "all",
        //         subFunction = "all",
        //         page = 1,
        //         pageSize = 50,
        //     }) => ({
        //         url: "/analytics/jobs/stage-details",
        //         params: {
        //             stage,
        //             period,            // leave blank to get all months, never force a specific month
        //             status,
        //             scope,
        //             counts_type: countsType,
        //             domain,
        //             function: fn,
        //             sub_function: subFunction,
        //             page,
        //             page_size: pageSize,
        //         },
        //     }),
        // }),

        // ── Job analytics by specific job ID ─────────────────────────────────
        getJobAnalyticsById: builder.query({
            query: ({
                jobId,
                groupBy = "month",
                periodCount = 6,
                status = "all",
                countsType = "cumulative",
            }) => ({
                url: "/acc/analytics/jobs/by-id",
                params: {
                    job_ids: jobId,
                    group_by: groupBy,
                    period_count: periodCount,
                    status,
                    counts_type: countsType,
                },
            }),
            keepUnusedDataFor: 60,
        }),

        // ── Stage-level candidate drill-down for a specific job ──────────────
        getJobStageDetails: builder.query({
            query: ({ jobId, stage }) => ({
                url: "/acc/analytics/jobs/by-id/stage-details",
                params: {
                    job_id: jobId,
                    stage,
                },
            }),
            keepUnusedDataFor: 30,
        }),
        getSubFunctions: builder.query({
            query: () => ({
                url: "/acc/dropdown/job-analytics/sub-functions",
            }),
            keepUnusedDataFor: 300,
        }),

        getCountries: builder.query({
            query: () => ({
                url: "/dropdown/countries",
                method: "GET",
            }),
            transformResponse: (response) => {
                if (Array.isArray(response)) return response;
                if (Array.isArray(response?.data)) return response.data;
                return [];
            },
            keepUnusedDataFor: 300,
        }),
    }),
});

// ── Export hooks ──
export const {
    useGetCandidateListByStatusQuery,
    useGetJobAnalyticsQuery,
    useGetJobsListQuery,
    useLazyGetStageDetailsQuery,
    useGetJobAnalyticsByIdQuery,
    useLazyGetJobStageDetailsQuery,
    useGetSubFunctionsQuery,
    useGetCountriesQuery,
} = dashboardService;
```

```javascript
    upgradeOrganisationToPayg: builder.mutation({
```

## File: redux/slices/authSlice.js

```javascript
import { createSlice } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

const initialState = {
  user: null,
  accessToken: null,
  refreshToken: null,
  loading: false,
};

const authSlice = createSlice({
  name: "auth",
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setCredentials: (state, action) => {
      const { user, accessToken, refreshToken } = action.payload;
      state.user = user;
      state.accessToken = accessToken;
      state.refreshToken = refreshToken;
    },
    logout: (state) => {
      state.user = null;
      state.accessToken = null;
      state.refreshToken = null;
    },
    setLoading: (state, action) => {
      state.loading = action.payload;
    }
  },
});

export const { setCredentials, logout ,setLoading} = authSlice.actions;
export default authSlice.reducer;
```

```javascript
// src/redux/slices/breadcrumbSlice.js
import { createSlice } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

const breadcrumbSlice = createSlice({
  name: "breadcrumb",
  initialState: { dynamicLabels: {} },
  reducers: {
    setDynamicLabels: (state, action) => {
      // merge — never wipes previous levels
      state.dynamicLabels = { ...state.dynamicLabels, ...action.payload };
    },
    clearDynamicLabels: (state) => {
      state.dynamicLabels = {};
    },
  },
});

export const { setDynamicLabels, clearDynamicLabels } = breadcrumbSlice.actions;
export const selectDynamicLabels = (state) => state.breadcrumb.dynamicLabels;
export default breadcrumbSlice.reducer;
```

```javascript
      state.loading = action.payload;
    },
    logout: (state) => {
      state.user = null;
    },
  },
});

export const { setUser, setLoading, logout } = candidateSlice.actions;
```

```javascript
import { createSlice } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

const initialState = {
  query: "",
};

const globalSearchSlice = createSlice({
  name: "globalSearch",
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setGlobalSearchQuery: (state, action) => {
      state.query = action.payload || "";
    },
    clearGlobalSearchQuery: (state) => {
      state.query = "";
    },
  },
});

export const { setGlobalSearchQuery, clearGlobalSearchQuery } =
  globalSearchSlice.actions;

export const selectGlobalSearchQuery = (state) =>
  state.globalSearch?.query || "";

export default globalSearchSlice.reducer;
```

```javascript
  if (!data) return null;
  try {

};
```

## File: utils/dashboardExportPdf.js

```javascript
import jsPDF from "jspdf";
import html2canvas from "html2canvas";

const PAGE_WIDTH_MM = 210;   // A4 portrait
const PAGE_HEIGHT_MM = 297;
const MARGIN_MM = 10;
const CONTENT_WIDTH_MM = PAGE_WIDTH_MM - MARGIN_MM * 2;
const CONTENT_HEIGHT_MM = PAGE_HEIGHT_MM - MARGIN_MM * 2;

const BRAND_BLUE = "#174FDF";
const TEXT_MUTED = "#6B7280";
const BORDER = "#E8ECF4";

/**
 * Renders a cover/header band onto a jsPDF doc — company name, report title,
 * generated-on timestamp, and the scope (user / organisation) being exported.
 */
function drawHeaderBand(doc, { title, scope, generatedAt }) {
  // Background band
  doc.setFillColor(BRAND_BLUE);
  doc.rect(0, 0, PAGE_WIDTH_MM, 28, "F");

  // Title
  doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
  doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
  doc.setFontSize(16);
  doc.text(title, MARGIN_MM, 14);

  // Subtitle row — scope + timestamp
  doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
  doc.setFontSize(9);
  doc.setTextColor(230, 235, 250);
  const scopeLabel = scope === "organisation" ? "Organisation view" : "My dashboard";
  doc.text(`${scopeLabel}  ·  Generated ${generatedAt}`, MARGIN_MM, 21);

  return 34; // y-offset where page content should start, in mm
}

/**
 * Draws a slim footer with page number on every page.
 */
function drawFooter(doc, pageNum, totalPages) {
  doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
  doc.setFontSize(8);
  doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
  doc.text(
    `Page ${pageNum} of ${totalPages}`,
    PAGE_WIDTH_MM - MARGIN_MM - 18,
    PAGE_HEIGHT_MM - 6,
  );
  doc.text(
    "Generated from Recruitment Dashboard",
    MARGIN_MM,
    PAGE_HEIGHT_MM - 6,
  );
}

/**
 * Captures a single DOM section to a canvas at a fixed scale for crisp output,
 * then converts it to a PNG data URL + its true mm dimensions on the page.
 */
async function captureSection(el) {
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) {
    throw new Error(
      `"${el.id || el}" has a zero-size box (likely display:"contents" or hidden) — skipping`
    );
  }

  const canvas = await html2canvas(el, {
    scale: 2,
    backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
    useCORS: true,
    logging: false,
  });

  if (canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
    throw new Error(`html2canvas produced an empty canvas for "${el.id || el}"`);
  }

  const imgData = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
  const widthMm = CONTENT_WIDTH_MM;
  const heightMm = (canvas.height * widthMm) / canvas.width;
  return { imgData, widthMm, heightMm };
}

/**
 * Adds an image to the doc, automatically starting a new page if it doesn't
 * fit in the remaining vertical space on the current page.
 * Returns the updated cursorY.
 */
function placeImage(doc, { imgData, widthMm, heightMm }, cursorY, pages) {
  const remaining = PAGE_HEIGHT_MM - MARGIN_MM - cursorY;

  // If the section is taller than a full page, it still gets placed on its
  // own page (oversized charts shouldn't get silently cut off) — jsPDF will
  // just render it starting fresh; for very tall single sections you may
  // want to split them further upstream, but this covers all normal cases.
  if (heightMm > remaining && cursorY > MARGIN_MM + 5) {
    doc.addPage();
    pages.count += 1;
    cursorY = MARGIN_MM;
  }

  doc.addImage(imgData, "PNG", MARGIN_MM, cursorY, widthMm, heightMm);
  return cursorY + heightMm + 6; // 6mm gap before next section
}

/**
 * Main export function.
 *
 * @param {Object} opts
 * @param {string[]} opts.sectionSelectors - CSS selectors (or element refs)
 *        for each dashboard section to capture, IN ORDER. e.g.:
 *        ["#dash-stat-cards", "#dash-pipeline-funnel", "#dash-requisitions",
 *         "#dash-charts-row-1", "#dash-charts-row-2"]
 * @param {string} opts.scope - "user" | "organisation"
 * @param {string} [opts.fileName] - defaults to a dated filename
 */
export async function exportDashboardToPdf({
  sectionSelectors,
  scope = "user",
  fileName,
}) {
  const doc = new jsPDF({ unit: "mm", format: "a4" });
  const generatedAt = new Date().toLocaleString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit",
  });

  let cursorY = drawHeaderBand(doc, {
    title: "Recruitment Dashboard Report",
    scope,
    generatedAt,
  });

  const pages = { count: 1 };

for (const selector of sectionSelectors) {
  const el = typeof selector === "string" ? document.querySelector(selector) : selector;
  if (!el) continue;

  try {
    const section = await captureSection(el);
    cursorY = placeImage(doc, section, cursorY, pages);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`PDF export: skipping section "${selector}" —`, err.message);
  }
}

  // Add footers to every page now that we know the final page count
  const totalPages = doc.internal.getNumberOfPages();
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    doc.setPage(i);
    drawFooter(doc, i, totalPages);
  }

  const finalName =
    fileName || `dashboard-report-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.pdf`;
  doc.save(finalName);
}
```
